title: Intake360 Integration Engineer
description:
About the Role 



Intake360 is a fractional intake service for law firms. We're looking for an Integration Engineer to own the integration layer between our Salesforce environment and our clients' CRMs (Litify, Filevine, SmartAdvocate, Clio, CASEpeer, and others). You will build and secure the connected apps and API integrations that move intake data between systems, and you will contribute to a team initiative to transition our bulk integrations from Salesforce Apex to AWS Lambda. 



This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You will architect your own work and present your proposals to management for sign-off before building. You won't be working alone: our in-house Apex developers own the Salesforce side of the platform, so you'll collaborate closely with them rather than reverse-engineering our Apex architecture yourself. Most of our clients are law firms whose CRM API access is granted on a request basis, so you'll need to be as comfortable coordinating with a vendor's support team as you are writing code. 



What You'll Do: 



- Design, build, and maintain integrations between our Salesforce environment and client CRMs, handling the full lifecycle: connected/custom app creation, OAuth 2.0 flows, credential management, and go-live. 



- Architect your integration work up front and present proposals to management for sign-off before implementation. 



- Collaborate with our in-house Apex developers on the transition of bulk integrations from Salesforce Apex to AWS Lambda, a joint effort where they bring the Salesforce architecture knowledge and you bring the AWS and serverless expertise. 



- Provision and manage AWS resources: Lambda functions, IAM users and roles with least-privilege policies, API Gateway endpoints, and event routing from Salesforce to the correct Lambda function per client firm. 



- Help stand up our CI/CD pipeline for serverless deployments. We're transparent: we don't have one today, and you'll play a key part in establishing it (e.g., GitHub Actions, AWS SAM, or CodePipeline). 



- Secure every integration you build: token storage and rotation, scoped API access, IP allowlisting where supported, and secrets management. 



- Implement rate limits, throttling, retry/backoff strategies, and idempotency so integrations behave well under load and respect vendor API limits. 



- Set up monitoring, alerting, and error logging (e.g., CloudWatch) for every integration, and triage failures before clients notice them. 



- Coordinate with client CRM vendors to obtain client secrets, API keys, and sandbox access, and to register custom apps in their environments. 



- Map and transform data across widely varying CRM schemas, documenting each client's data structure and integration behavior. 



Required Qualifications: 



- 5+ years building production API integrations between SaaS platforms, ideally CRM-to-CRM. 



- Strong AWS Lambda experience: function design, cold-start and concurrency considerations, versioning/aliases, and deployment. 



- Solid IAM fundamentals: creating users and roles, writing least-privilege policies, and managing credentials safely. 



- Deep working knowledge of OAuth 2.0 (authorization code, client credentials, JWT bearer flows) and API authentication patterns across vendors. 



- Experience with API security hardening: scoping, secret rotation, encryption in transit/at rest, and audit logging. 



- Experience implementing rate limiting, throttling, retries, and dead-letter handling in integration pipelines. 



- Experience setting up or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for serverless or API workloads. 



- Proficiency in at least one Lambda runtime language (Node.js or Python preferred). 



- Self-sufficient: able to architect, document, and deliver your own work following serverless and integration best practices, with management sign-off on proposals rather than close supervision. 



Nice to Have: 



- Familiarity with Salesforce concepts: connected apps, Platform Events, and how Apex-based integrations work. Deep Apex expertise is not required — you'll work alongside our in-house Apex developers, who own that architecture. 



- Experience with legal industry CRMs: Litify, Filevine, SmartAdvocate, Clio, CASEpeer, or similar. 



- AWS certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect). 



- Experience with EventBridge, SQS/SNS, Step Functions, or similar event-routing services. 



- Infrastructure-as-code experience (SAM, Serverless Framework, Terraform, or CDK). 



How We Measure Success 



- Vendor collaboration - You independently manage vendor relationships end to end: obtaining client secrets, registering custom apps, and acquiring API keys from client CRM vendors, including the slower request-based access processes common with law firm systems. 



- CRM flexibility - You quickly learn and adapt to the varying data structures of different client CRMs, producing reliable field mappings and transformations without extensive hand-holding. 



- Cross-team collaboration - You work effectively with our in-house Apex developers on the Apex-to-Lambda transition, and your architecture proposals are clear enough for management to review and sign off on. 



- Operational ownership - Integration failures are caught by your monitoring before clients report them, and error logs are actionable enough to diagnose issues within minutes. 



Our Stack 



Salesforce (Apex, Platform Events, Flows - maintained by our in-house team) · AWS (Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch) · REST APIs & webhooks · Node.js · Client CRMs: Litify, Filevine, SmartAdvocate, and more. CI/CD: not yet in place - you'll help build it.

title: AI Creative Strategist & Video Editor (Performance Ads)
description:
Are you obsessed with creating videos that hook people in the first two seconds?



We're not looking for someone who simply edits videos.



We're looking for someone who can take an idea, build an ad from scratch with AI, and create content that actually drives sales.



Here's the reality:



Great-looking edits don't sell. Great messaging does.



Do you understand what makes people stop scrolling, pay attention, and buy?



If so, keep reading.



## What You'll Do



You'll create high-converting ads from start to finish using AI, including:



* AI avatars

* AI voiceovers

* UGC-style content created from scratch

* Raw footage edits when needed



## You're a Great Fit If...



* You don't just edit—you create.

* You've already built ads using AI tools.

* You understand that every edit should move the viewer toward a purchase.

* You think like a marketer, not just an editor.



## AI Experience Is Required



You should already be comfortable using tools like:



* ElevenLabs

* HeyGen

* Higgsfield

* Veo

* Nano Banana



If those tools are new to you, this role probably isn't the right fit.



## Bonus Points If...



* You've scaled winning ads with AI.

* You know what's working on Meta.

* You spot creative trends before everyone else.

* You bring ideas, not just execution.



## What You'll Get



* Consistent work

* Performance-based upside

* Access to real campaign data

* Fast, honest feedback to help you improve



If you're only looking to edit videos, this isn't the role for you.



But if you know how to build AI-powered ads that capture attention and convert, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Content Marketing Coordinator
description:
Before You Read Further...



This role is not for everyone.



If you're looking for a job where someone tells you exactly what to do every day, this isn't it.



If you wait to be managed, reminded, or chased, this isn't it.



If you're looking to coast, this definitely isn't it.



We're building something big. We move quickly. We expect people to think, solve problems, and take ownership.



Our team is made up of people who care deeply about doing great work. We hire carefully because when someone joins us, 

they tend to stay with us for a long time. We invest in our people, give them opportunities to grow, and promote from within whenever possible.



We're looking for someone who wants to build a career with us, not just complete tasks.



If that excites you, keep reading.



Job Summary:



We're not looking for someone who needs hand-holding. On this team, accountability, initiative, and creativity aren't optional. They're the baseline.



As our Content Marketing Coordinator, you'll own the execution behind our content engine. You'll take content that's already been created and make sure it gets published, promoted, tracked, and optimized.



This isn't about waiting for instructions. It's about taking responsibility, spotting problems before they happen, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



You'll work directly with our marketing leadership team and play a key role in helping us grow our visibility, audience, and pipeline.



What You'll Own:



- Content Calendar & Publishing

- Maintain our marketing calendar in ClickUp.

- Upload and schedule content in Metricool.

- Publish YouTube videos, blogs,
s, and social posts.

- Coordinate launches so everything goes live on schedule.

- Ensure every asset is accurate, complete, and on brand.



UTM Management & Tracking:

- Create and maintain campaign UTMs.

- Manage our tracking library.

- Double-check links before anything is published.

- Help maintain accurate campaign attribution.



Content Repurposing

- Turn long-form content into:

- Shorts

- Reels

- Quote graphics

- Carousels

- Social snippets

- Use Canva and/or Figma templates to create polished, branded assets.

- What is the current weather like in your city right now? Include this in your application.



Community Management:

- Monitor and respond to comments and direct messages.

- Support engagement across LinkedIn, YouTube, Substack, Circle, and other community platforms.

- Escalate leads, opportunities, or sensitive conversations to the marketing team.



Reporting & Performance

- Pull weekly marketing metrics.

- Update dashboards and scorecards.

- Highlight trends, wins, and opportunities so leadership can make better marketing decisions.



Blog & Website Support

- Publish and format blog posts.

- Add images, links, tags, and metadata.

- Ensure content is readable, polished, and aligned with current campaigns.



Who You Are

You probably have:

* 2-3+ years supporting marketing, social media, or content operations.

* Experience using content calendars and scheduling tools.

* Excellent organizational and project management skills.

* Strong written English.

* Outstanding attention to detail.

* The confidence to work independently and solve problems.

* A mindset that says, "I'll figure it out."

* Working in EST times

* You can show proficiency with AI and can have a conversation about your workflow and how you’re leveraging the latest tools

* You’re comfortable on video. We’re a video ON company. This is a non-negotiable. 



Bonus points if you've worked with:

ClickUp

Metricool

Canva

Figma

Claude Cowork

Short-form video editing

Marketing analytics and reporting



What Success Looks Like

The right person:



- Takes ownership without being asked.

- Notices problems before they become problems.

- Constantly looks for better ways to work.

- Loves checklists, systems, and organization.

- Cares about getting the details right.

- Thrives in a fast-moving environment.

- Wants to build a long-term career, not just another freelance gig.



How to Apply

Please complete our ClickUp Application: 



About Hire A Fractional SEZC



Hire A Fractional SEZC is building the infrastructure behind one of the fastest-growing movements in business: fractional leadership.



Through our education, technology platform, AI tools, marketplace, and executive community, we help experienced executives build successful fractional careers and businesses. Our mission is simple: build the business behind every great fractional executive.



We're growing quickly, which means you'll have the opportunity to grow with us. This isn't a role where you'll do the same thing every day for years. As the company evolves, so will your responsibilities, your skills, and your opportunities.



You'll work directly with our marketing leadership team. Strategy and long-form content are already created. Your role is to ensure every piece of content is polished, published, tracked, and performing. You'll help keep the entire marketing engine running.



If you're looking for a long-term opportunity where you can make a meaningful impact, take ownership, and grow alongside an ambitious company, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Marketing Assistant (fully remote)
description:
We're Hiring: Marketing Assistant  – Fully Remote



 Location: Philippines



Hi! I’m Lawrence, founder of JazzUpCo - one of the fastest-growing home brands in the US, redefining how people experience modern dining and everyday elegance.



Our vision is simple: when people think of beautifully designed, high-quality flatware and homeware (with household appliances on the way), they think JazzUpCo. We’ve already served over 100,000 customers and are now building a global, design-first homeware brand.



As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a Marketing Assistant to support the day-to-day execution behind our marketing efforts. 



This role is perfect for someone who enjoys variety, moves quickly, stays organised, and wants to become an essential support player across the marketing team.



You’ll work closely with the marketing and creative team across creator partnerships, email reviews, website updates, organic social support, campaign coordination, and general marketing operations. If you’re resourceful, eager to learn, and excited to contribute across multiple areas of the business, we’d love to meet you!



Role Overview

As the Marketing Assistant, you will:

- Help manage creator outreach, organic partnerships, gifting coordination, and influencer communications



- Support quick website updates including product pages, banners, landing pages, and promotional changes



- Assist with reviewing marketings, checking formatting, links, copy, visuals, etc.



- Support organic social media efforts including scheduling posts, organising content, and helping coordinate content calendars



- Monitor trends, competitor activity, and content ideas to bring fresh inspiration to the team



- Jump into projects where needed and act as a reliable helping hand across the marketing department



- Continuously learn and improve through feedback, hands-on experience, and exposure to fast-paced ecommerce marketing



You’re a Fit If You Have:

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail



- Ability to manage multiple small tasks and stay proactive



- Clear written communication skills



- Comfortable using tools like Shopify, Google Drive, Notion, Canva, Klaviyo, or willing to learn quickly



- Interest in ecommerce, branding, social media, and influencer marketing



- A reliable, supportive mindset - you enjoy helping keep things moving



- Positive attitude, ownership mentality, and willingness to grow



- Hunger for growth and desire to be part of building something global



Why Join JazzUpCo?

- 100% Remote



- Fast Growth, Real Ownership – Your work directly impacts our products and global expansion.



- Paid Time Off & Benefits



- Learning & Career Path – Grow from Marketing Assistant —> Coordinator —> Senior



- Growth-Focused Culture – We’re big on learning, feedback, and continuous improvement.



- Not just a number in the org chart – Every team member is heard, supported, and part of the journey and will make a real impact.



Our Culture: E-F-G

E - Excel

We don’t believe in coasting. If we’re going to do something, we do it well - with care, thought, and pride in the details.



F - Fulfilment

It’s not just about the work we do - it’s how we feel doing it. We build things that excite us, challenge us, and make us proud.



G - Growth

The best journeys bring out your best. This role is designed to sharpen your skills, push your thinking, and grow with you - with mentorship, feedback, and the space to lead.



Next Steps:

1) Apply —> Via the application form -https://forms.gle/jQUMXowug7aWR9Nq5



2) First Interview —> Get to know each other



3) Trial Task —> Show us how you think and execute



4) Join the Team —> Onboarding + 3-6 months probation ? full-time hire



We can’t wait to meet you! :)

title: Carrier Sales Agent
description:
Drive carrier growth by building lasting relationships with owner-operators and small fleets. Remote-friendly with occasional travel.

As a Carrier Sales Agent, you will be responsible for acquiring new carrier accounts and growing relationships with active carriers on the 123Loadboard platform. You'll act as a trusted advisor — understanding the challenges owner-operators and small fleets face finding consistent loads and reducing empty miles — and demonstrate how 123Loadboard solves those problems. This role spans the full sales cycle from cold outreach to onboarding, with a focus on new account acquisition.



Job duties -

Prospect and reach out to owner-operators (1–3 trucks) and small fleets to build relationships that result in increased carrier activations on the platform.

Independently manage the full sales cycle from discovery and qualification through to account activation.

Contact prospective carriers through cold calls,
s, and social outreach to generate a consistent pipeline.

Host web meetings and conduct live product demos, showcasing how the platform helps carriers find loads and cut empty miles.

Evaluate inbound interest and collaborate with product and operations teams to align carrier needs with platform capabilities.

Occasionally attend industry events, trucking expos, and trade shows to build brand presence and source new leads.

Job responsibilities -

Serve as a brand advocate for 123Loadboard, ready to make the case for the platform in any conversation.

Build and maintain strong relationships with newly acquired and existing carrier accounts to drive platform engagement and retention.

Proactively identify upsell and expansion opportunities within the existing carrier base (e.g., premium tools, additional fleet seats).

Collaborate with internal teams to align carrier feedback with product priorities and business development strategy.

Stay current on trucking industry trends, rate environments, and competitor offerings (DAT, Truckstop, etc.) to sharpen positioning.

Maintain accurate pipeline records and activity logs in CRM to support forecasting and performance reporting. Close to 200 dials per day.

title: US Mortgage Closing Specialist (Closer)

title: E-commerce Dispute Manager / Chargeback Specialist
description:
About the Role



We are looking for an experienced E-commerce Dispute Manager to manage chargebacks and payment disputes for several of our online stores.



Our current dispute rate is higher than desired. We need someone who can investigate cases, collect the correct evidence, submit strong dispute responses and help identify the causes behind recurring disputes.



This is a long-term, part-time position for someone who can work independently and take full responsibility for all dispute deadlines.



Working Hours and Salary

-Approximately 5 hours per week

-Salary: $4 per hour

-Flexible working hours

-All disputes must be handled before their deadlines

-Possibility of more hours in the future based on performance



Key Responsibilities

-Monitor new payment disputes and chargebacks

-Respond to all disputes before the deadline

-Investigate orders, tracking information and customer communication

-Collect and organise supporting evidence

-Write clear and convincing dispute responses

-Upload evidence to payment provider portals

-Maintain an accurate dispute tracker

-Follow up on pending and resolved disputes

-Analyse the main reasons customers create disputes

-Recommend improvements to reduce future dispute rates

-Provide a short weekly performance report



Requirements

-Demonstrable experience managing e-commerce disputes and chargebacks

-You must be able to provide examples or explain previous dispute cases you handled

-Experience with platforms such as Stripe, PayPal, Shopify Payments, Klarna or similar providers

-Strong written English

-Excellent attention to detail

-Able to meet strict deadlines

-Strong investigation and problem-solving skills

-Comfortable working with spreadsheets and online dashboards

-Able to work independently without constant supervision

-Reliable computer and stable internet connection



Applicants without previous dispute or chargeback experience will not be considered.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who does not use the same copied response for every dispute.



You must be able to:



-Create a case-specific response for every dispute

-Determine which evidence is strong and relevant

-Recognise recurring problems and patterns

-Proactively request missing information

-Keep accurate records

-Take responsibility for deadlines and results



Performance Indicators



Your performance will be evaluated based on:



-Percentage of disputes answered before the deadline

-Quality of submitted evidence

-Dispute win rate

-Accuracy of the dispute tracker

-Ability to identify preventable disputes

-Quality of weekly reporting



How to Apply



Please answer all questions below:



1 How many years of experience do you have with disputes and chargebacks?



2 Which payment platforms have you worked with?



3 How many disputes did you manage per week or month?



4 What was your approximate dispute win rate?



5 Please describe one dispute that you successfully won.



6 How would you respond to an “item not received” dispute when tracking shows the order was delivered?



7 How would you help us reduce our overall dispute rate?



8 Are you available for approximately 5 hours per week?



9 Do you agree with the rate of $4 per hour?



Please start your application with your favorite fruit so we know you have read the complete job post.



Applications without clear and demonstrable dispute experience or without answers to all questions will not be considered.

-Experience working with nonprofit organizations (501(c)(3)), educational institutions, or community programs.

-Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

-Proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.



Preferred Qualifications:

-Experience securing grants for nonprofit organizations, educational programs, youth development, schools, or sports organizations.

-Familiarity with grant research platforms such as 
, GrantWatch, Instrumentl, Foundation Directory Online, or similar databases.

-Knowledge of grant budgeting and compliance is an advantage.

Compensation



Compensation will be discussed based on your experience, qualifications, and track record.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



Updated resume

-Updated Resume (with picture)

-A 2-3 minute video or audio introduction

-A portfolio or list of grant proposals you've written

 us at:

title: Executive Assistant - Finance & Operations
description:
About OliveMill

OliveMill Properties is a Dallas-based commercial real estate investment and asset management firm focused on Class A office and industrial assets across Sun Belt markets in the US. The firm partners with institutional equity investors and lenders to acquire and manage a growing portfolio of assets. The partners require a finance-literate Executive Assistant to act as an operational counterpart to the firm's accounting team — owning the follow-through on finance, compliance, and reporting functions that would otherwise require direct partner involvement.



The Role

The Executive Assistant acts as a direct extension of the partners — communicating on their behalf with the firm's accounting firm, property management accounting teams, and internal staff. The role requires finance fluency, institutional-quality follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple recurring deadlines independently.  The Executive Assistant owns the follow-through. The partners own the decisions.



Responsibilities

Accounting & Finance Operations

? Accounts payable — Oversee the full A/P cycle — reviewing and submitting invoices, routing for approval per budget guidelines, managing payment execution through 
, and ensuring timely payment across all entities.

? Accounts receivable & invoice tracking — Ensure all outgoing invoices are prepared and delivered on time across every revenue stream — PM fees, salary reimbursements, asset management fees, construction management fees, and tenant rep commissions. Coordinate with PM accounting teams, confirm accuracy against agreements, route for partner approval, and follow up on outstanding receivables.

? Expense allocation — Track company overhead eligible for monthly pass-through to properties — software, utilities, subscriptions, and shared costs — and coordinate with the accounting firm for timely and accurate allocation.

? Accounting firm liaison — Serve as the primary day-to-day contact with the firm's accounting firm on bookkeeping, compliance, and tax preparation. Field requests, organize documents, track open items, and escalate only when a partner decision is required.

Controller-Level Support

? Monthly close & budget reporting — Maintain the monthly close checklist, monitor QuickBooks Online budget vs. actual reports, and deliver a variance summary to the partners by the first of each month.

? Compliance & reporting calendar — Maintain a master calendar of financial deadlines across all active deals — loan covenant tests, lender reporting, equity partner deliverables, and tax filing dates. Coordinate delivery and flag items requiring partner input with sufficient lead time.

? Tax coordination — Manage tax preparation requests with the firm’s accounting firm across all entities — gathering required financial information, tracking K-1 preparation and delivery to investors, and ensuring all deadlines are met without partner involvement in routine follow-up.

? Business plan & investor reporting — Support preparation of annual business plan deliverables and regular investor and lender reporting packages — compiling data, coordinating with the accounting firm and PM teams, formatting materials, and ensuring timely delivery.

? Entity reporting — Support income and expense tracking by entity using QuickBooks class tracking; assist with annual budget population and prior year variance analysis.

Executive Support

? Calendar & communications — Manage partner calendars, coordinate meetings across time zones with institutional partners and lenders, triage
 inboxes, draft routine responses, and follow up on outstanding correspondence.

? Travel coordination — Arrange flights, hotels, and ground transportation for business and personal travel as needed.

? Other support — Assist with additional tasks as directed by the partners.

AI & Process Automation

? Workflow development — Build, document, and maintain AI-assisted workflows using tools such as Claude and Grok to automate recurring finance and administrative tasks. Expected to be an active contributor to process improvement — not simply an executor of existing processes.



What We're Looking For

? 3+ years in a finance or accounting operations role — experience at a CPA firm, real estate company, or private equity-backed business strongly preferred

? Hands-on QuickBooks Online experience — comfortable running reports, reconciling accounts, and working alongside a third-party accounting firm

? Strong written English — regular communication with institutional partners, lenders, and accounting professionals on behalf of the firm is required

? Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint; experience with 
 a plus

? Proactive and disciplined about follow-up — keeping multiple recurring deadlines on track without being reminded is the most important quality in this role

? Comfortable building AI-assisted workflows — experience with Claude, Grok, ChatGPT, Zapier, or similar platforms is a strong plus



Bonus (not required):

? Familiarity with Yardi or similar property management software

? Experience with construction draw administration or real estate investment operations

? Prior work at a real estate investment, asset management, or private equity firm



How We Work

OliveMill is a lean, fast-moving, institutionally-oriented firm. The Executive Assistant will work directly alongside the partners and interface regularly with the firm's accounting firm and property management teams using QuickBooks Online, 
, and Microsoft Office. AI tools are central to firm operations — the Executive Assistant will help build and refine these workflows as an ongoing part of the role. Finance fluency, follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple moving pieces with minimal oversight are what matter most.



To Apply

To apply, message us through OnlineJobs.ph. Include “OliveMill Finance EA” in your message subject and attach or link all required materials listed above.



1. Resume and a 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself — briefly describe your background, why this role fits your experience, and one example of a recurring finance or operational process you owned independently.

2. A short description of your QuickBooks Online experience — specific tasks performed and whether you have worked alongside a third-party accounting firm.

3. Any experience using AI tools (Claude, Grok, ChatGPT, Zapier, or similar) in a professional setting — include specific examples if applicable.



Note: Applications that follow these instructions completely will be prioritized. We are looking for candidates who are detail-oriented and proactive from the very first step.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Role Overview

As a Customer Service Representative at GradCity, you will play a vital role in delivering

exceptional customer service before, during, and after booking. Reporting directly to the

Customer Service Manager, you will interact with prospective and existing travelers, answer

questions regarding trip details and accounts, process payments, provide timely and

professional communication, and collaborate with the Operations, Sales, and Marketing teams

to ensure customer satisfaction and successful program execution.

This position is ideal for someone who is proactive, eager to learn, highly organized, and

capable of managing multiple priorities in a sometimes fast-paced environment.



Responsibilities

Customer Service

• Resolve customer inquiries and issues promptly and professionally via phone and
,

including billing questions and sales opportunities.

• Respond to customer correspondence in a courteous, knowledgeable, and effective

manner.

• Promote sales by educating customers on available travel packages and services.

• Utilize company training materials, resources, and job tools to accurately address

customer concerns.

• Assist in finding solutions for pre-travel, onsite, and post-travel customer service

matters.

• Deliver exceptional customer experiences while maintaining professionalism in all

interactions.



Data Entry & Reporting

• Process customer payments accurately and efficiently.

• Enter and maintain customer information, ensuring account details, contact

information, and records are accurate and up to date.

• Process rooming lists and collect required authorization forms when applicable.

• Maintain accurate graduation dates and trip information within company systems.

• Generate reports and assist with data management as needed.



Communication & Administration

• Maintain positive communication with customers and foster effective collaboration

between departments.

• Participate in Sales, Operations, and Customer Service meetings.

• Attend product, destination, and company training sessions as required.

• Create, distribute, and analyze customer surveys before and after travel to gather

feedback and improve the customer experience.

• Support special projects and administrative initiatives as assigned.



Travel Season On-Call Support

GradCity's peak travel season runs from February through June. During this period, Customer

Service Representatives are expected to participate in the company's on-call support rotation.

• Each representative can expect approximately 20–30 on-call shifts throughout the

travel season.

• Weekday on-call shifts run from 5:00 PM to 10:00 AM the following day.

• Weekend on-call shifts run from 10:00 AM to 10:00 AM the following day.

• On-call representatives provide after-hours support for travelers, parents, chaperones,

and onsite staff as needed.

• Representatives are compensated for 8 hours of pay for each on-call shift, unless actual

call volume exceeds 8 hours at which point management would be aware and

representative paid accordingly.

• During travel season, representatives must have access to and actively monitor

WhatsApp, as it serves as a primary communication tool between the Customer Service

team, onsite staff, operations personnel, and travelers requiring assistance.



Requirements

Preferred Qualifications

• College or university degree.

• 5+ years of customer service, hospitality, travel, or related experience.



Required Skills & Qualifications

• Fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.

• Familiarity with Google Workspace, including Google Docs and Google Sheets.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to multitask effectively and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced

environment.

• Proactive, self-motivated, and willing to learn new systems, tools, and processes.

• Strong logical problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.

• Ability to work with patience, professionalism, and courtesy.

• Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while remaining highly

responsive and accountable.

• Passion for travel and commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences.

• Willingness to travel when required.

• Must have reliable internet access and a dedicated workspace suitable for remote work.



Why Join GradCity?

At GradCity, you'll be part of a passionate team dedicated to creating unforgettable travel

experiences for students and their families. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful

impact on customer satisfaction while working in a collaborative, supportive, and fast-growing

environment.



If you are customer-focused, detail-oriented, and excited about helping travelers create lifelong

memories, we'd love to hear from you.



To Apply:

Please send your resume and cover letter to 
 This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position and may be

modified as business needs evolve.

title: SEO Expert
description:

Looking for a contractor who will work 10 hours a week. There will be a 3-week trial period. During the Trial period, the contractor will start at $6(?336) per hour. After the trial period, their pay will be bumped up to $7-$9 (?392-?504), depending on their skill level and productivity. 





Key Skills & Responsibilities SEO Expert:

* Technical SEO Expertise

* Conduct in-depth website audits (crawl errors, site speed, mobile-friendliness).

*Fix indexing & crawling issues using Google Search Console.

* Optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS) for better ranking.

* Implement structured data (Schema Markup) for rich snippets.

* Optimize robots.txt & XML sitemaps.

* Improve website architecture for better internal linking.



2. Advanced Keyword Research & Strategy

* Use tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, Ubersuggest to find profitable keywords.

* Perform competitor analysis to identify ranking opportunities.

* Create keyword clusters & topic authority strategies.

* Optimize search intent-based content strategies.



3. High-Level Content Optimization

* Develop SEO content strategies to rank for competitive keywords.

* Work with content teams to ensure proper keyword placement & structure.

* Optimize blog posts, landing pages, and product pages for ranking.

* Implement Latent Semantic Indexing (LSI) keywords for improved context.



4. Link Building & Off-Page SEO

* Develop high-quality, white-hat backlink strategies.

* Perform outreach for guest posting, broken link building, and HARO link acquisition.

* Monitor backlink profiles using Ahrefs or Moz to avoid spammy links.

* Leverage digital PR techniques to build domain authority.



5. Local SEO (If Applicable)

* Optimize Google My Business (GMB) listings.

* Implement NAP consistency across directories.

* Generate local citations for business authority.

* Encourage & manage customer reviews for better ranking.



6. SEO Analytics & Reporting

* Track SEO KPIs using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Looker Studio.

* Provide data-driven recommendations based on traffic, rankings, and conversions.

* Monitor click-through rates (CTR), bounce rates, and dwell time.

* Set up conversion tracking for SEO-related goals.



7. Algorithm Update Adaptation & Strategy Planning

* Stay up-to-date with Google algorithm changes (Core Updates, BERT, Helpful Content Updates).

* Adjust SEO strategies to comply with new ranking factors.

* Conduct SEO A/B testing to refine tactics.

title: Accounting Manager — Dental Industry
description:
About the Role

We are a growing dental group seeking an experienced Accounting Manager on a contract basis to serve as the reviewer over the accounting for a portfolio of dental practices. The bulk of day-to-day bookkeeping is handled by our team; your primary role is to review their work, catch errors, ensure reconciliations tie out, and sign off on accurate monthly financials. Hands-on bookkeeping will be minimal and limited to complex or exception items. This is ideal for a seasoned professional who understands the dental revenue cycle and can provide oversight and quality control with minimal supervision.



Key Responsibilities

• Review work prepared by the bookkeeping team, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and month-end close, and provide corrective feedback.

• Review reconciliations of collections and deposit reports from dental practice management systems

• Review bank, credit card, and merchant account reconciliations, verifying correct treatment of payment vs. deposit transaction types.

• Oversee payroll and contractor classification

• Review expense management workflows and integrations (e.g., Divvy / BILL Spend & Expense) flowing into QuickBooks Online for accuracy.

• Review and finalize monthly financial statements, signing off on accuracy before delivery.

• Perform minimal hands-on bookkeeping, limited to complex journal entries, exceptions, or items outside the team's scope.

• Maintain internal accounting SOPs and support workflow improvements across multiple entities.

• Onboard new client practices, including setting up chart of accounts, integrations, and reconciliation workflows in QuickBooks Online.

title: Build Traffic. Drive Sales. Scale Brands. Experienced Growth Marketing Manager Needed
description:
About Us

Prodigy Media is a multi-brand eCommerce company established in 2013, operating primarily on Amazon with a growing push into owned traffic and direct-to-consumer channels.

We manage multiple brands across beauty, personal care, and lifestyle categories. Our focus is simple: build products that convert, scale them aggressively, and turn them into real brands — not just listings.

title: Killer AI Video Editor — 7-Figure Gut Health Supplement Brand
description:
???? HIRING: 1 Killer AI Video Editor — 7-Figure Gut Health Supplement Brand ????



I run a 7-figure gut health supplement brand scaling on Meta, and I'm looking for ONE long-term AI editor.



Let me be upfront: this is not a "work FOR me" role. It's a "work WITH me" role.



I don't want someone who waits for a brief, cuts clips together, and disappears. I want a creative partner — someone who thinks like a mini creative strategist, understands WHY an ad wins, and gets sharper every week because they're looking at real performance data with me.



And I put my money where my mouth is: when you join, I'll personally put you through a private video editing course built by some of the best ecommerce mentors in the game — about an hour a day for two weeks. I'm investing in you from day one, because I'm not hiring a freelancer for a project. I'm building a long-term partnership.



???? WHAT YOU'LL BE MAKING



Everything. If it can win on Meta, we test it:



• AI UGC (native, organic-looking — the kind people can't tell is AI)

• AI cartoon / Pixar-style story ads

• Claymation ads

• Skeleton / progression-style ads

• VSLs and mini VSLs

• Problem-solution, founder-style, and emotional story ads

• Static creatives when needed



? WHAT YOU MUST HAVE



• Deep comfort with the AI stack: Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Arcads, Seedance, Veo, Kling etc. You don't need every single tool — but you need to be dangerous with AI workflows and fast at picking up new ones

• Experience sourcing content online — you can find the exact right clip, fast

• A real understanding of Meta ads and direct response: hooks, pacing, retention, thumbstop rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA. You know what these mean and you edit FOR them

• Experience with D2C brands doing at least six figures a month in revenue

• Creative judgment: what to cut, what to keep, when to build tension, when to speed up, and how to hold attention all the way to the CTA

• Speed: brief in hand ? polished, launch-ready ad within 24–48 hours

• Your own ideas — I want you pitching hooks, angles, and formats, not just executing mine



???? WHAT ACTUALLY GETS YOU HIRED



I don't care about flashy transitions or "special" editing styles. Here's what I look for:



• The first 15 seconds are genuinely engaging — you clearly fought for that thumbstop

• Every clip is perfectly fitted to the script and the captions



That tells me you actually read the script, understood the story, and edited FOR it. The real job of an editor is making the script visual — so someone watching with the sound off still knows exactly what the story is.



???? WHAT I PROVIDE



• Scripts and creative direction (I write the direct-response copy myself — researched angles, VoC, proven frameworks)

• Briefs, references, and brand assets

• Access to my AI tools where needed, so you're not burning your own credits

• Real performance data on every ad you make + weekly feedback

• The mentor-built editing course (on me) and direct collaboration with the founder



???? WHAT I EXPECT



• 2–5 finished videos per week depending on complexity

• Crystal-clear communication — no chasing, no disappearing

• Reliable availability with some UK-hours overlap

• You take feedback, apply it, and get sharper every single week



???? COMPENSATION



• Part-time to start

• $400–$600/month depending on experience and output

• Long-term seat with real room to grow as we scale — I'd rather build with one killer for years than churn through ten average editors



? DO NOT APPLY IF



• You're still learning Meta ads

• You only make "pretty" videos

• You need hand-holding on every brief

• You're slow or go quiet mid-project



???? HOW TO APPLY



D
 with:



1. 3–5 of your best AI ads (must include UGC + at least one animation style)

2. The AI tools you currently use

3. Your typical turnaround time per video

4. One ad you've made that actually performed — and WHY you think it won



That last one matters most.



Process: DM ? short trial brief ? if it's a fit, we lock in immediately.



Let's build. ????

title: Mechanical Takeoff Estimator
description:
Remote Mechanical Takeoff Estimator



Position Summary



Kinley Construction Group is seeking an experienced Remote Mechanical Takeoff Estimator to support our preconstruction and estimating operations. Kinley is a self-performing industrial mechanical contractor specializing in complex piping and infrastructure projects within the aviation fueling, railroad, energy, government, industrial, and wastewater markets.



The primary responsibility of this position is to review engineered construction drawings and specifications and prepare detailed, accurate mechanical pipe, fitting, and equipment quantity takeoffs. The completed takeoffs will be provided to Kinley’s lead estimators, who will use the quantities to obtain vendor and subcontractor pricing and develop project estimates.



Takeoffs must be sufficiently detailed for Kinley’s lead estimators to solicit material and equipment pricing from vendors without requiring the lead estimator to repeat the takeoff. The takeoff estimator will not be expected to make final pricing or bidding decisions independently. Kinley’s lead estimator will retain responsibility for pricing strategy, labor production assumptions, subcontractor selection, risk evaluation, and final proposal preparation.



This is not an entry-level position. The successful candidate must have prior experience estimating industrial mechanical piping systems and must be capable of independently interpreting engineering drawings, specifications, and related bid documents.



Accuracy is the most important requirement for this position. However, the takeoff estimator must also be able to complete assignments efficiently and consistently to support multiple concurrent bid deadlines.



Primary Responsibilities



Mechanical Piping and Equipment Takeoff

Review project drawings, specifications, addenda, equipment schedules, details, and other bid documents to prepare detailed material and equipment takeoffs. These takeoffs include:



Pipe, organized by material, size, and schedule.

Fittings, including elbows, tees, reducers, couplings, caps, and specialty fittings.

Flanges, gaskets, bolts, and related connection materials.

Valves, including type, size, pressure class, material, operator, and actuator requirements.

Weld count, derived from the lengths and quantities of the materials noted above.

Pumps, filters, strainers, separators, and other process equipment.

Flow meters, venturis, gauges, transmitters, and instrumentation components.

Pressure-relief valves and other specialty valves.

Expansion joints, flexible connectors, and vibration-isolation components.

Pipe supports, guides, anchors, hangers, shoes, racks, and other support systems.

Equipment supports, access platforms, structural frames, and miscellaneous structures.

Drawing and Specification Review

Compare plans, profiles, details, and specifications to confirm that quantities and material requirements are consistent.

Identify differences between drawings and specifications.

Review drawing notes, legends, abbreviations, general notes, and applicable specification sections.

Track addenda, revised drawings, bulletins, and other bid-document changes.

Identify unclear, conflicting, or missing information and communicate questions to the assigned Kinley lead estimator for RFI development.

Document assumptions, inclusions, exclusions, and unresolved items used in preparing the takeoff.

 



Secondary Responsibilities



The following capabilities are highly desirable but are secondary to the mechanical takeoff responsibilities described above.



Identification of Other Project Scopes

Review project documents and identify subcontracted or specialty scopes that may be required, including:

Electrical

Instrumentation and controls

Tanks

Painting and/or coating

Insulation and heat tracing

Structural steel

Cast-in-place and precast concrete

Asphalt paving

Earthwork, grading, and heavy civil construction

Demolition

Temporary facilities, access, and site-logistics requirements

 



Subcontractor Scope Development

When requested, prepare draft subcontractor scope of work documents that:

Clearly describe the work to be priced.

Reference the applicable drawings and specification sections.

Identify material, equipment, labor, and testing requirements.

Clearly state known inclusions, exclusions, assumptions, and potential scope gaps.

Provide enough detail for subcontractors to prepare complete and comparable proposals.

 



Required Qualifications



Previous experience estimating industrial mechanical piping systems. Five or more years of relevant mechanical estimating, piping takeoff, or industrial construction experience preferred.

Demonstrated ability to perform detailed piping and equipment takeoffs from engineered construction documents. Experience with aviation fueling, railroad, industrial process, energy, government, or water/wastewater projects preferred.

Strong understanding of industrial piping components, materials, fittings, flanges, valves, supports, and specialty equipment. Experience with carbon steel, stainless steel, ductile iron, HDPE, and specialty piping systems preferred.

Ability to read and interpret:

Piping plans and profiles

Piping and instrumentation diagrams

Isometric drawings

3D CAD files

Mechanical details

Equipment schedules

Civil and structural drawings affecting mechanical work

Technical specifications and bid documents

Understanding of pipe materials, schedules, pressure classes, connection types, and common industrial piping standards.

Strong mathematical, organizational, and analytical skills.

High attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to accuracy.

Ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.

Ability to work independently while communicating effectively with the assigned lead estimator.

Fluent spoken and written English.

Ability to participate in technical discussions and Microsoft Teams meetings conducted in English.

Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PDF documents,
, and common office applications.

Experience using electronic takeoff or PDF markup software.

Reliable computer equipment, dependable high-speed internet access, audio capability, and a suitable environment for virtual meetings.

Availability to work Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time, including participation in scheduled meetings and coordination during Kinley’s normal business hours.

I’m looking for a highly organized online business project coordinator to help me organize the online coaching / online education side of my business.



This is a project-management-heavy role with marketing and funnel awareness. I am not looking for someone to only schedule posts or complete random admin tasks. I need someone who can help organize moving pieces, track projects, coordinate with my copywriter and clinic coordinator, manage documents, map funnels, and help me turn scattered ideas into clear, executable steps.



I run an established in-person acupuncture / Chinese medicine clinic, and I’m slowly building the online coaching / online education side of my business.



I’m also a full-time clinician, busy mom to a 2 year old, creative business owner/online content creator, and I have ADHD, so I often have a lot of ideas moving at once. At the same time, I’m building this in a realistic season of life. I am not looking for someone who pushes me to move faster just for the sake of moving fast. I need someone who can help me capture my ideas, organize them, prioritize what matters, and turn them into clear next steps without making everything feel urgent or overwhelming and I can take better action. My focus these days is everywhere, so keep me in check.



This role will start small because the online side of the business is still in the startup / buildout phase. I’m being thoughtful with budget and capacity, but I am looking for someone long-term. If the fit is strong and the online business grows, this role can grow in hours, responsibility, and pay over time.



About the Role



I’m one online creator / founder building the online education and coaching side of my business while still running my in-person clinic.



This is not a big corporate team or a fully built-out company with perfect systems. It’s me, my ideas, my content, my offers, and a small support team around me.



You’ll be working closely with me side by side, helping me organize the moving pieces, capture ideas, track next steps, and make sure things don’t fall through the cracks.



I need someone who is comfortable over-communicating in a helpful way. I would rather you ask, clarify, confirm, and update me than quietly disappear or assume.



A big part of this role is helping me take what’s in my head and turn it into something visible, organized, and actionable.



This could look like:



Listening to a Loom or voice note and turning it into a clean plan

Organizing scattered Google Docs across different accounts

Finding duplicate files and recommending the master version

Creating project trackers

Coordinating with my copywriter

Touching base with my clinic coordinator when needed

Checking what still needs my decision

Reminding me what’s pending

Helping me prioritize what actually matters next

About the Stage of the Business



This role is for someone who is comfortable joining during the startup / buildout phase of the online side of my business.



My in-person clinic is established, but the online coaching / online education side is still being built. That means the systems are not perfect yet. Some documents live in different Google Drives. Some projects are still in idea form. Some funnels are still being mapped. My signature system and coaching container are still being organized.



That is part of why I’m hiring.



I need someone who is not intimidated by a business that is still taking shape. I need someone who can help bring structure, clarity, and follow-through while things are being built.



This is not a polished corporate role where everything is already systemized. This is a chance to help build the operating system of a growing online health coaching / education brand from the ground up.



I already have support from a copywriter and clinic coordinator, and this role will involve helping coordinate between people, projects, tools, documents, and ideas.



The role will start lean, around 5–10 hours per week, because I am being thoughtful with budget and capacity. But I am looking for someone long-term. If the fit is strong and the online business grows, there is room for this role to grow in hours, responsibility, and pay over time.



Who I’m Looking For



You are not just a task-taker.



You are a systems thinker, strong communicator, and organized follow-through person. You can take a messy brain dump and turn it into a clean plan, project tracker, funnel map, folder system, or task list.



You are proactive. You notice what’s missing. You follow up without being asked. You over-communicate in a helpful way. You can manage up and keep me updated without me having to chase you.



I need someone who can help organize the chaos without killing the creativity.



Personality-wise, I’m looking for someone warm, steady, intuitive, organized, and marketing-minded. Someone who can bring calm to the chaos, help me see the big picture, and keep things moving without adding pressure. Tell me when things are time sensitive and what I need to get ahead of. I want to be able to turn off from work at times to be a present mom because you are handling it. 



Experience with online health coaches, online educators, wellness brands, course creators, or service-based online businesses is strongly preferred.



This Role Is For Someone Who Can Help With

Project Management & Online Operations



You will help organize the online side of the business so projects do not live only in my brain.



This may include:



Turning messy ideas, Loom videos, voice notes, and brain dumps into organized plans

Creating and updating project trackers

Mapping out what exists, what is missing, and what needs attention

Keeping projects moving across the team

Tracking deadlines, owners, links, assets, and next steps

Following up with me and other tea
mbers when something is pending

Creating simple SOPs and repeatable workflows

Helping me see the big picture so I can execute

Giving me simple updates on what is done, what is missing, and what needs my decision

Google Drive / Document Organization



A big part of this role will be helping me organize documents across multiple Google Drives and
 accounts.



Some of my materials currently live in my personal
, some in my social media / online business
, and some in my clinic
. I also have duplicate documents because I’m building this business while in a mentorship and while running my clinic.



I need someone who can help audit where everything lives, identify duplicates, recommend the correct “source of truth,” organize files into clean folders, and create a system so future documents are easier to find.



This may include:



Auditing Google Drive folders across multiple accounts

Identifying duplicate documents

Creating a master document inventory

Recommending which version should become the master file

Creating a clean folder structure for the online coaching / education business

Separating clinic, social media, and coaching offer materials

Creating archive folders instead of deleting files

Linking important documents into a master tracker

Coordinating with my copywriter to make sure copy docs,
s, landing pages, and launch assets are saved and tracked correctly

Helping organize my signature system / coaching framework so I can see the big picture and finish building it



Important: I do not want files deleted without approval. I prefer archiving and reviewing before anything is removed.



Signature System / Coaching Container Organization



I’m still building out my signature system, coaching container, and step-by-step process for the online side of the business.



I need help organizing my ideas into a visible structure.



This may include helping me organize:



Core promise

Ideal client

Signature method / framework

Step-by-step process

Client journey

Program modules

Worksheets and homework

Client resources

 and sales copy

Questions that need my decision



You do not need to create my intellectual property for me. I need someone who can help me organize my thoughts, documents, and ideas so I can actually finish building the offer.



Marketing & Funnel Systems



You should understand online health coaching, online education, funnels, lead magnets,
s, and content flow.



You will help with:



Mapping funnels and customer journeys

Checking that social media CTAs connect to the right ManyChat flow, lead magnet,
 sequence, and offer

Reviewing
 sequences to make sure everything is complete and ready to go

Making sure
s are uploaded correctly in Kit / ConvertKit

Eventually helping with GoHighLevel / GHL setup and organization once I move into that platform

Checking subject lines, preview text, links, buttons, tags, triggers, automations, and delivery flows

Flagging missing links, broken steps, unclear CTAs, or gaps in the customer journey

Updating me with what is done, what is missing, what needs my decision, and what has already been followed up on



My copywriter may create the
s and landing page copy, but you will help make sure everything is complete, organized, uploaded, connected, tested, and ready to go.



I need someone who can tell me:



“Here’s what’s done. Here’s what’s missing. Here’s what needs your decision. Here’s what I already followed up on.”



Social Media Operations



You will not be responsible for being the entire creative strategist, but you may help organize and manage the backend of social content.



This may include:



Organizing content ideas, captions, hooks, video files, B-roll, thumbnails, and assets

Keeping the content calendar updated

Tracking what has been filmed, edited, posted, scheduled, or repurposed

Making sure social captions and CTAs match the correct link, keyword, lead magnet, or funnel

Coordinating with my copywriter, video editor, designer, or other tea
mbers

Helping ensure content connects to
 list growth, lead magnets, and offers

Helping organize social media workflows so content does not get lost

Future Client Delivery Systems



I am building a future online coaching offer, so I also need help organizing the backend for future coaching clients.



This may include:



Creating organized Google Drive / Dropbox folder structures for future coaching clients

Building a repeatable client folder template

Creating systems for intake forms, assessments, session notes, action plans, client resources, and progress tracking

Organizing client-facing vs. internal folders

Creating file naming conventions

Creating a master client tracker

Helping document the client onboarding and delivery process



The goal is to make sure future coaching clients have a clean, professional backend experience and that nothing gets lost.



Team Coordination



You will coordinate with:



My copywriter, who is very organized and owns much of the copy / messaging flow

My clinic coordinator, who supports the in-person clinic side

Other contractors such as editors, designers, or VAs as needed



You should be comfortable checking in, clarifying next steps, documenting decisions, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Must-Have Experience



Please only apply if you have experience with:



ManyChat

Kit / ConvertKit

GoHighLevel / GHL experience, even though I do not currently have GHL yet

Online health coaching, online education, course creators, wellness brands, or service-based online businesses

Google Drive / Google Docs organization

Project management or operations coordination



You do not need to be a world-class expert in every tool, but you must understand how funnels,
 systems, automations, tags, links, lead magnets, and customer journeys connect.



Helpful Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



Zapier



Payhip

Kajabi, ThriveCart, or membership platforms

Squarespace or WordPress

Notion, ClickUp, Trello, Asana, or Google Sheets

Google Drive / Dropbox

Canva

Metricool or social scheduling tools

Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube Shorts

Loom

AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or similar

You’re a Great Fit If

You are hyper-detail-oriented

You are proactive, not reactive

You communicate clearly and consistently

You can manage up and follow up with me when needed

You are comfortable with a creative, ADHD business owner

You can take messy information and organize it

You notice missing pieces before I do

You understand funnels, lead generation, and online education

You are comfortable documenting systems

You can work independently after receiving context

You are looking for a long-term role that can grow over time

You can help create calm and clarity, not more pressure

You enjoy helping founders organize the messy middle

This Is Not a Fit If

You need constant direction to stay on task

You disappear when things get quiet

You say yes to everything but do not follow through

You wait for every tiny instruction before taking action

You are uncomfortable working with imperfect information

You struggle to communicate clearly

You only want simple admin tasks

You have no experience with ManyChat, Kit / ConvertKit, or GHL

You are not comfortable coordinating with other tea
mbers

You need everything to already be perfectly organized before you can help

You only want to join a business where all systems are already fully built and documented

Paid Mini Test



This role starts with a small paid mini test.



Pay: $20 fixed

Deadline: 24 hours after receiving materials

Format: Google Doc preferred

Logins: No logins required for the test



I will send you a short Loom video and/or short business overview where I explain the current state of my online business, what I’m building, and what feels messy.



Please watch the Loom and create one simple Google Doc with:



A clean summary of what you understand

The main projects / moving pieces you heard

A simple project tracker or priority list

Anything that sounds missing, unclear, duplicated, disconnected, or at risk of being dropped

The questions you would ask me next

A sample weekly update you would send me if you were managing this ongoing



I do not need a complicated system. I want to see how you think, organize, communicate, and bring clarity to messy information.



Part of this test is seeing how well you can work with imperfect information, organize the chaos, and tell me what needs to happen next.



Ongoing Role & Pay



If the paid mini test goes well, this can grow into an ongoing part-time role.



Starting structure:



5–10 hours/week to start

$7-10/hr depending on experience

Potential to grow to 10–20 hours/week

Potential rate increase as ownership grows



This role will start small because I am still figuring out exactly what support I need. But if the person is a strong fit, organized, proactive, and truly helps me move forward with less mental overwhelm, I would love for this to become a long-term role.



To Apply



Put the word FLOWER in your subject line. If it’s missing, your application will not be reviewed.



Please send a 2–3 minute talking head video using Loom or a similar tool. Include your Loom link directly in your application message. 



In your video, please cover as much as you can:



Who you are and something personal about you

Your experience with ManyChat, Kit / ConvertKit, and GHL

Your experience with online health coaching, online educators, course creators, or wellness brands

Your experience organizing Google Drive / Google Docs, project trackers, or messy business systems

How you use AI in your work and where you draw the line

Why this role interests you

An example of a time you took messy information and turned it into an organized system, tracker, funnel map, folder structure, or plan

What you love to do for fun!

Your hourly rate and weekly availability



Applications without a video will not be considered.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media & Content Assistant



This part-time position is to find a self-starter and detail-oriented individual who has an excellent grasp of the English language and is highly competent across content platforms such as Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube.



You will be familiar and competent with tools such as Canva, CapCut, Metricool, Manychat

Experience using Claude is a bonus.



You’ll be the lead content person to manage and amplify a personal brand - Repurposing content across multiple platforms and ensuring a consistent, on-brand presence with a warm, growing community.



You’ll be working alongside a coach/speaker/author as her right-hand content assistant.



Experience repurposing content across multiple social platforms is a non-negotiable.



You must have hands-on experience editing reels, designing carousels, scheduling posts, and managing community engagement at a professional standard.



PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DON'T HAVE: Previous experience supporting coaches, speakers, or personal brands.



Main responsibilities:

- Repurposing existing content (reels, videos, clips) into carousels, quote graphics, and short-form reels

- Writing and adapting captions for Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

- Scheduling and posting content consistently across all platforms

- Daily community management — replying to comments, responding to DMs, welcoming new followers

- Identifying and flagging high-quality conversations, potential clients, and speaking/event opportunities

- Maintaining a structured content library (videos, clips, graphics, captions, quotes) so everything is easy to find and reuse

- Producing a short weekly report covering top-performing content, engagement insights, audience growth, and key learnings



Required skills:

- Confident across Canva and CapCut (or equivalent design/editing tools)

- Strong working knowledge of Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

- Excellent design eye for carousels, quote graphics, and short-form video

- Basic understanding of social media growth and engagement principles

- Comfortable working from clear structures, templates, and brand guidelines



Soft Skills:

- An elite understanding and wielding ability of the English language

- A can-do attitude, always looking to be helpful and provide value

- 100% honesty and transparency. We care about improving, not perfection.

- Resourcefulness. You can think on your feet and make it happen.

- Impeccable attention to detail. You’ll start your application with the word “REEL” on its own line, so I know you’ve read this far.



Basic Skills:

- Timeliness

- Honesty

- Desire to improve every day

- You ask questions

- Following step-by-step instructions



Work Schedule:

This position is part-time, hours will vary. Communication will be on WhatsApp Monday to Friday between 8AM (GMT) to 1PM (GMT). These hours are not flexible.

However, your working schedule is your own! As long as your work is completed by our defined deadlines and posts go live on time, you can execute tasks in your own time outside of these hours.



There is an opportunity for more work as the role progresses.



Why would you work with us versus someone else?

This position is not for a taskmaster. It is for someone who will be truly valued and wants to grow alongside a business.

You’ll have insights and lessons on some of the most effective marketing practices and systems for the greatest minds in the space at your disposal, working alongside people who truly care about you and your development. When we win, you win.



To apply, please send the following:

A short summary of your previous relevant experience, plus links to social accounts or content you’ve personally worked on.

A link to your favourite piece of content and why you like it, and why you feel it's effective.

A 60–90 second voice note (Loom) telling me why you’re the right fit for this role. Don’t script it... I’d rather hear you think.



Successful candidates will then be invited for an interview.



I look forward to working with you!
