title: Full Time Video Editor
description:
We're looking for a Full-Time Video Editor! 



You’re not here to just “edit videos.” You’re here to build attention at scale.



If you’ve ever looked at a YouTube video and thought, “I know exactly why this works”... keep reading.



What You’ll Actually Be Doing:

This role is simple in structure… but high in impact.

You will take raw content and turn it into engaging, optimised, performance-driven videos across: YouTube (long-form) TikTok + Instagram (short-form)



That means:

- Editing long-form YouTube videos that hold attention and drive clicks

- Collaborating with the team to shape video ideas and angles

- Writing/optimising titles, descriptions, and thumbnails with YouTube SEO in mind

- Scheduling and managing uploads

- Repurposing content into short-form clips that people actually watch to the end

- Focusing on highly engaging short-form content (Hooks, Retention time, ASMR etc) 

- Tracking performance and improving based on real data (not guesses)



What We’re Looking For:



We’re NOT looking for a “task editor.” We’re looking for someone who understands WHY content performs.



You should:

- Have experience editing for YouTube (and ideally growing channels)

- Understand YouTube SEO (Titles, CTR, retention, thumbnails etc)

- Know how to structure videos for watch time and engagement

- Be confident creating short-form content that hooks instantly

- Understand key metrics like: Hook rate, Retention time, Drop-off points

- Be able to look at a video’s performance and think: “Here’s what we fix next time.”



If you just follow instructions, this won’t work.

If you think, test, and improve... You’ll thrive here.



What Makes This Role Different:

You’ll be joining a small, fast-moving team that’s scaling quickly.



That means:

- Your work will have a direct impact

- Your ideas won’t get buried in layers of approval

- You’ll grow as fast as you can handle



And here’s the extra bonus:

You’ll have access to the training, systems, and thinking of an 8-figure CMO, meaning you’re not just editing…You’re learning how content actually drives revenue.



We handle production & filming.

Your job is to take what’s created and turn it into high performing video content.



The opportunity....



Right now, you’re either:

Editing videos for an agency or as a freelancer and being told to prioritise quality over quantity.

Or you know you’re capable of more, but don’t have the right environment to thrive.



This role fixes both.



Because when you combine:

- Strong content

- Clear strategy

- And someone who understands performance…Growth stops being random.



Don’t send a generic application.



Complete the questions below, and be sure to include:

Examples of YouTube videos you’ve edited (with results if possible)

Your portfolio of short form content

A quick breakdown of: What makes a video perform in your opinion



We’re not hiring based on CVs.

We’re hiring based on how you think.

title: Ecommerce Operations Manager
description:
Are you an experienced Ecommerce Operator who enjoys problem-solving and thinks in systems? Then this is the role for you…



We are a UK-based, family-run fragrance company in need of operational excellence to support our current growth. Whilst the company has been established for over a decade, this area of the business is very much being built.



**The Role**

As Ecommerce Operations Manager, you'll manage the day-to-day operations of our Shopify Store, D2C channels & TikTok Shop, including implementation of inventory management and AI customer service tools as well as building operational processes and SOPs. 



You'll sit within a wider ecommerce team that includes a dedicated Amazon Team, an internal

Commercial Director and external agency partners for both Shopify and TikTok. Directors hold

senior responsibility for stock management and logistics strategy.



**The day-to-day**

In a nutshell - Management of day-to-day operations, documentation of process, recommending improvements, ensuring implementation actually happens.

This is a hands-on role. We need someone who gets things done, not someone who advises from afar.



What You'll Do - 

• **Shopify / D2C:** fulfilment process, stock management, customer service, and the operational setup needed to scale a D2C channel from an early stage properly

• **TikTok Shop:** manage TikTok Shop operations end-to-end, including Fulfilled By TikTok (FBT)

management and FBM fulfilment process; work closely with our TikTok agency on execution

and performance

• **Stock & inventory management:** oversee stock management across TikTok Shop and Shopify; manage stock and CS for eBay and Amazon FBM through shared tooling; lead implementation of an inventory management system

• **Customer service:** manage CS processes across all channels in scope; oversee selection and

implementation of an AI-powered CS platform to automate high-volume, repeatable queries;

own the process from setup through to handover. 

• **SOPs & process:** document operational processes and SOPs for all the above — written clearly enough that the wider team can run them consistently without relying on you

**• Reporting & KPIs:** Own operational reporting and communication with all stakeholders, including tracking of KPI’s and operational metrics such as: *(FBT fill rates, out-of-stock reporting, order defect rate, return rate etc)*



**Essential Requirements:

•** Proven hands-on experience with TikTok Shop operations, including Fulfilled By TikTok (FBT)

• Direct experience managing Shopify at an operational level: fulfilment, stock, and day-to-day platform management

• Experience working with an inventory management system: Cin7, Linnworks, Brightpearl or

similar; specific platform matters less than having done it before

• Experience managing customer service processes across marketplace channels: owning the

process and the quality of output, not just responding to tickets

• A multi-channel background: comfortable with the operational differences between FBT, FBM

and D2C; knows what good looks like across each

• A doer: this is a management and execution role; you'll get things done and be accountable

for how they run, not just recommend and move on

• Have previous experience working with a start-up



**Desirable Requirements:**

• Experience managing eBay or Amazon FBM operations.

• Experience implementing customer service tooling or automation across marketplace

channels

• SOP writing and process documentation

• Experience working with or managing agency partners

• Familiarity with the beauty, fragrance or lifestyle category



**About You:**

• Superior communication and interpersonal skills

• Able to prioritise tasks, and communicate problems rapidly with the leadership team.

• Proactive self-starter who enjoys working as part of a small team

• Skilled at building strong relationships

• Competent working under pressure and taking the initiative

• Good at handling multiple tasks and highly organised

• Able to organise, prioritise, and keep track of tasks



Work Schedule:

This position is full-time; hours will be based on UK time zone, expected from 9am UK till 5pm UK. These hours are not flexible.



Salary is dependent on experience.



Why would you work with us versus someone else?



This position is not for a taskmaster. It is for someone who will be truly valued and wants to grow alongside a business.

You’ll be instrumental in building out our internal operations and supporting a fast-growing team, willing to give you what you need to succeed in the role; working alongside people who truly care about you and your development. There is also room for role development: When we win, you win. 



IMPORTANT: To Apply



Please detail your previous employment, including companies, role held and core responsibilities. 

Please give me an example of a system or a process you implemented and how you determined whether it was successful

You will tell me if you prefer Tea or Coffee in your application

You will tell me why you feel you'll be a good fit for this role

You'll tell me why you left your last role and what your availability is like. 



Qualified Candidates will have an interview, a time-bound task, and then final stage interview. 



Good Luck!

title: Brand Film Director & AI Creative Systems Editor
description:
Read This Before You Apply

This is not a social media editing position.

This is not a content creator role.



This is not a "video editor" position.



We are building premium digital brands across multiple industries. Every project must establish credibility, communicate expertise, and create trust within seconds.



You'll create flagship website films, brand stories, product launches, recruiting campaigns, customer testimonials, corporate documentaries, executive interviews, and high-converting digital content.



If your work depends on templates, trendy transitions, or copying what is currently popular on social media, this role is not for you.



If your work consistently communicates emotion, trust, and authority through visual storytelling, we want to meet you.



Mission

Transform raw footage into premium brand assets that increase trust, engagement, and conversions.

Every project should answer three questions almost immediately:



Why should someone trust this company?

What makes this organization different?

Why should a customer choose them?

You will create films that become the centerpiece of websites, advertising campaigns, investor presentations, recruiting initiatives, and digital marketing systems.

What You'll Do

You'll receive footage from many different industries, including professional services, construction, healthcare, real estate, manufacturing, hospitality, education, technology, athletics, nonprofit organizations, and local businesses.

Your responsibility is not simply to edit footage.



Your responsibility is to discover and communicate the story hidden within it.



You will:



Review extensive libraries of raw video

Identify emotionally compelling moments

Build narrative through sequencing

Produce premium brand films

Create website hero videos

Develop customer testimonial videos

Produce executive interview content

Build recruiting and employer branding campaigns

Edit product launch videos

Produce social campaigns from flagship content

Deliver desktop, mobile, and social versions

Optimize all deliverables for performance across web platforms

Required Technical Expertise

Applicants should demonstrate mastery in most of the following.

Professional Editing

Adobe Premiere Pro

Adobe After Effects

DaVinci Resolve

CapCut Desktop (advanced proficiency)

Adobe Media Encoder

AI Production Workflow

You understand how AI accelerates professional production without replacing creative judgment.

Experience should include several of the following:



Adobe Firefly

Premiere AI

Runway

Topaz Video AI

AI object removal

AI stabilization

AI audio enhancement

AI scene detection

AI reframing

AI masking

AI transcript editing

AI workflow automation

Motion Design

Experience producing:

Logo animations

Motion graphics

Kinetic typography

Lower thirds

Interface animations

Infographics

Corporate presentation graphics

Cinematography Knowledge

You understand:

visual composition

lighting

movement

pacing

rhythm

color theory

shot selection

emotional sequencing

sound design

visual hierarchy

storytelling through editing

Brand Strategy

You understand the difference between:

A promotional video.



A corporate video.



A commercial.



A documentary.



A recruiting film.



A flagship brand story.



Every project should reinforce positioning, authority, and trust—not simply look attractive.



You Are Probably NOT a Fit If...

You primarily create:

TikTok edits

Instagram trend videos

Gaming montages

Wedding videos

Generic YouTube intros

Template-based reels

Fast-cut highlight compilations

We're looking for someone who builds brands—not someone who stacks clips together.

You ARE a Fit If...

You think like a filmmaker.

You edit with intention.



You understand when to slow down.



You understand when to create tension.



You understand when silence is more powerful than music.



You remove beautiful shots because they weaken the story.



You care more about narrative than effects.



You obsess over pacing.



You believe great editing is invisible.



Technical Deliverables

Ability to deliver:

4K masters

Website hero videos

Mobile-first versions

Social media derivatives

Optimized web compression

Motion graphic packages

Source project files

Color LUTs

Organized production assets

Bonus Qualifications

Experience with:

Drone cinematography

Corporate documentary production

Commercial advertising

High-end agency work

Product marketing

UI animation

Web video optimization

Photography

Sound design

Creative direction

Brand strategy

Creative AI workflows

Submission Requirements

Applications without the following will not be reviewed.

1. Portfolio

Provide five projects demonstrating different styles of storytelling.

2. Your Best Work

Submit the single best 30–60 second piece you've ever created.

3. Story Breakdown

For one portfolio piece, explain:

Why you selected each scene

Why each cut occurs where it does

How you created emotional progression

What business objective the film was designed to accomplish

4. Workflow

Describe your complete production workflow from raw footage through final delivery.

Include where AI assists your process and where creative judgment remains entirely manual.



5. Software Stack

List every tool you regularly use, including editing, motion graphics, AI, color grading, audio, asset management, and collaboration platforms.

Practical Evaluation

Finalists will receive identical raw footage from a real client.

Your assignment is to produce a flagship brand film suitable for the client's website.



We are not evaluating how many effects you can add.



We are evaluating your ability to:



Discover the story

Build trust

Create emotion

Communicate professionalism

Deliver a commercially effective brand asset

What We Value Most

Software can be learned.

Templates can be purchased.



AI can automate repetitive tasks.



Exceptional judgment cannot.



We're hiring someone who understands how visual storytelling influences perception, trust, and decision-making. The strongest candidates will consistently transform ordinary footage into compelling brand experiences that help businesses communicate credibility, differentiate themselves in competitive markets, and drive measurable business outcomes.

title: Data Validation Coordinator (Healthcare)
description:
About the Role

In this role, you will review clinical documentation, validate data accuracy, ensure records meet company standards and HIPAA requirements, and prepare documentation for final storage and billing workflows.



Responsibilities

Review clinical session notes for accuracy, completeness, and compliance.

title: Head of Marketing and Creative Operations
description:
World Corp Digital is seeking an exceptional, hands-on Head of Digital Marketing and Creative Operations to lead our marketing strategy, creative production, brand visibility, and promotional campaigns.



We want an experienced marketing professional who can make our companies, products, websites, and digital platforms visible across relevant online channels.



This will initially be a hands-on position. The successful candidate must be able to personally create graphics, edit photographs, produce videos, develop content, manage social media, improve SEO, and execute advertising campaigns.



As the company hires additional graphic designers, video editors, content creators, and marketing workers, the position will gradually become more focused on department leadership, creative direction, campaign management, delegation, and quality control.



The successful candidate must therefore be capable of both producing high-quality marketing work personally and managing other professionals effectively.





Work Location and Relocation



The application process, practical assessment, and interviews will be conducted online. The successful candidate will work remotely from the Philippines until approximately February 2027.



This position is not intended to remain permanently remote. The successful candidate is expected to relocate to a company location in Central America around March 2027 and work from a company office after relocation.



The company will sponsor and coordinate the required work authorization and immigration process.



The exact country, city, immigration arrangements, office details, and housing information will be disclosed to shortlisted candidates during the initial interview and before they complete the practical assessment.



Please apply only if you are genuinely willing to consider long-term international relocation.





Employment and Compensation



This is a full-time, stable, long-term position reporting directly to company management.



The proposed compensation and relocation package includes:



- USD 2,500 monthly base compensation

- Company-provided two-bedroom apartment

- Company-paid electricity and basic utilities

- Company-paid internet and television service

- Medical insurance

- Transportation allowance

- One company-paid round-trip flight to the Philippines each year

- Paid vacation leave

- Long-term opportunity to shape the company’s marketing and creative direction



The employee will generally be responsible for their own food and personal expenses.



Complete compensation, tax treatment, working hours, leave conditions, immigration assistance, housing rules, and other employment terms will be stated in the final written employment agreement.





Primary Responsibilities



The successful candidate will generally be responsible for:

- Developing and executing the company’s overall marketing strategy.

- Increasing the visibility of our companies, products, websites, and digital platforms.

- Planning and managing organic and paid marketing campaigns.

- Managing SEO, social media, Google advertising,
 marketing, content marketing, video promotion, and other relevant channels.

- Conducting audience, market, keyword, competitor, and campaign research.

- Establishing campaign objectives, budgets, schedules, and performance targets.

- Creating and editing graphics, photographs, videos, advertisements, social media posts, presentations, and other marketing materials.

- Managing marketing content, publishing calendars, and brand accounts from a marketing perspective.

- Monitoring analytics, leads, conversions, campaign costs, and return on investment.

- Testing and improving advertisements, creative materials, audiences, landing pages, and campaign strategies.

- Establishing and maintaining consistent branding, messaging, and creative standards.

- Recruiting, training, supervising, and evaluating graphic designers, video editors, content creators, and other remote marketing workers as the team grows.

- Reviewing and approving marketing and creative work before publication.

- Providing management with clear reports, recommendations, and early warnings about underperforming campaigns.

- Taking ownership of campaigns from planning and production through publication, measurement, and optimization.





Required Experience and Qualifications



Applicants must have:



- At least seven years of professional experience in digital marketing, advertising, brand management, creative operations, or a closely related field.

- At least three years of experience managing marketing personnel, creative workers, contractors, agencies, or remote teams.

- Strong practical experience with SEO, analytics, paid advertising, social media, content strategy, and campaign optimization.

- Demonstrated ability to plan, launch, manage, measure, and improve complete marketing campaigns.

- Professional graphic-design capabilities.

- Professional photo-editing and image-enhancement capabilities.

- Professional video-editing and production capabilities.

- The ability to personally produce polished marketing materials without depending entirely on other tea
mbers.

- Experience managing marketing budgets and evaluating campaign performance and return on investment.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Strong project-management, organization, prioritization, and quality-control skills.

- A portfolio containing relevant marketing, graphic-design, photo-editing, video-editing, SEO, or campaign work.

- The ability to work independently while maintaining reliable communication and accountability.



A university degree in marketing, communications, business, design, media, or a related field is helpful but not mandatory. Demonstrated ability, leadership, measurable results, and high-quality work are more important.





Marketing and Creative Tools



Applicants should be comfortable using professional tools for:



- SEO and keyword research

- Website and campaign analytics

- Paid advertising

- Social media management

-
 marketing

- Graphic design

- Photo editing

- Video editing

- Content planning

- Project and team management



Relevant tools may include Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or comparable professional platforms.



Applicants do not need to use every listed tool, but they must demonstrate strong capability with an appropriate professional toolset.





AI-Assisted Marketing



World Corp Digital uses modern AI-assisted tools and expects the successful candidate to use them responsibly.



Experience with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Canva AI, Adobe Firefly, Runway, Midjourney, Descript, CapCut AI, or similar platforms is valuable.



The successful candidate must be able to use AI to improve research, planning, content creation, design, photo editing, video production, analysis, and reporting while carefully reviewing all output for accuracy, quality, originality, confidentiality, and brand consistency.



The successful candidate will remain professionally responsible for all marketing and creative work they approve or publish.





How to Apply



Apply directly through OnlineJobs.ph.



Use this subject line:



WCD Head of Marketing – [Your Full Name]



Begin your application message with this exact sentence:



“I have read the complete World Corp Digital marketing job post.”



Then number and briefly answer the following questions:



1. How many years of professional marketing experience do you have, and how many years have you managed marketing or creative workers?



2. Briefly describe the strongest marketing campaign you personally planned or managed. Include the channels used, your responsibilities, and the measurable results.



3. Briefly describe your strongest SEO achievement and the results it produced.



4. Which marketing, analytics, advertising, graphic-design, photo-editing, video-editing, and AI tools do you use professionally?



5. Provide links to your portfolio, graphic designs, photo-editing work, videos, campaigns, case studies, website, or LinkedIn profile. Clearly identify which work you created personally and which work was completed by a team you managed.



Finally, answer yes or no to each of the following:



- Are you willing to complete an online practical assessment if shortlisted?

- Are you genuinely willing to relocate to Central America around March 2027?

- Are you comfortable with the proposed USD 2,500 monthly base compensation and relocation package?



Attach your updated resume or CV.



Applications that do not follow the instructions, do not answer the questions, or consist only of a generic message such as “I am interested” may not be reviewed.



Applications will be handled confidentially. Only candidates selected for the next stage will be contacted.

title: Freelance Educational Video Editor
description:
Help Build a Premium Educational Brand That Changes Lives



We are a Swiss health and educational company with a start up section which helps women achieve lasting Weight Freedom through evidence-based education, practical tools, and compassionate coaching.



We're building a premium educational brand, not an influencer channel, and we're looking for a freelance video editor to become a long-term creative partner.



If you enjoy YouTube, love creating clear educational content, and are excited about using AI to work smarter, we'd love to hear from you.





Your Mission



Your job is simple: Turn the owner's knowledge into engaging educational videos that are clear, trustworthy, and enjoyable to watch. You'll edit YouTube videos today, while helping us build premium courses, workshops, and future educational content as we grow.



Our goal isn't flashy editing, it's helping people learn.





What You'll Do



Core Responsibilities



* Edit talking-head educational and webinar-style videos

* Improve pacing and viewer engagement

* Clean and enhance audio

* Add subtitles and captions

* Create simple graphics and text overlays

* Export videos for YouTube

* Follow our established editing style

* Deliver projects reliably and on time





Nice to Have



Over time, we'd also love your help with:

* Uploading videos to YouTube

* Creating descriptions, chapters, playlists, cards, and end screens

* Designing thumbnails

* Creating Shorts from long-form videos

* Organizing project files and backups

* Improving our production workflow



We're Looking For Someone Who...

* Has at least 1 year of regular YouTube editing experience (or an equivalent portfolio)

* Has good spoken English

* Understands YouTube pacing, hooks, and viewer retention

* Is comfortable editing talking-head educational content

* Can clean audio and create simple graphics

* Is reliable and communicates well

* Enjoys learning and improving



AI Is a Plus



You don't need to be an AI expert. But you should enjoy experimenting with tools that make creative work faster and better. Examples include ChatGPT, Whisper, Adobe AI, Descript, CapCut AI, Canva Magic Studio, or similar tools.





Our Editing Philosophy



We care more about helping people learn than impressing them with editing. That means:



* Clarity over flashy effects

* Learning over entertainment

* Trust over clickbait

* Authenticity over hype



Every edit should support the teaching, not distract from it.





What Success Looks Like



Within your first few months, you'll understand our editing style, deliver videos with minimal revisions, and significantly reduce the manager's editing workload. Most importantly, you'll become a trusted creative partner as our educational company continues to grow.





Working Together



This is a freelance, project-based position with ongoing weekly work. We're looking for someone who enjoys building long-term relationships. As our company grows, there may be opportunities for increased responsibility and a more permanent role. Compensation will be based on your experience and portfolio.





Why Join Us?



You'll be helping build an educational company that genuinely changes lives. Instead of creating content purely for views, you'll help women build healthier relationships with food, their bodies, and themselves. You'll work directly with the founder, help shape the future of the brand, experiment with AI-assisted workflows, and grow alongside a mission-driven business from an early stage.





How to Apply



Please send us:



* A short introduction written by you (not generated by AI because we value honesty and authenticity more than perfect wording)

* Your CV or LinkedIn profile

* Links to videos you've personally edited with a brief description of your role in those projects

* How many years of YouTube editing experience you have

* Which editing software and AI tools you use

* Your availability and time zone

* Your freelance rate (hourly and/or per project)



We don't expect perfection. We're looking for someone reliable, curious, and excited to build something meaningful with us.



We're looking forward to hearing from you. 



Angela Buhri

description:
About the Role



Houston LASIK & Eye is a premier vision correction center based in Houston, Texas. We are seeking a highly disciplined, fast-moving, and bilingual (English/Spanish) Remote Patient Intake & Administrative Operations Assistant to report directly to the Company Owner.  Work is US business hours.



IMPORTANT: This is a dynamic, hybrid role requiring absolute focus. You will be dealing directly with prospective surgical vision correction patients, while simultaneously executing internal administrative checklists. This is a role for a disciplined executor, not a strategist. You will be trained to perform daily tasks exactly according to the Owner’s established workflows—not your own.



The core of this job is flawless daily consistency, split-second responsiveness, and zero-reminder execution. If we have to remind you to follow up with leads or complete your tasks, this partnership will not work.Key Responsibilities & Core Duties



Instant Patient Lead Response (Priority 1): Monitor incoming leads for surgical vision correction. You must instantly reach out to new leads via text message and phone calls to qualify them and book appointments.

CRM Data Pipeline Management: Log every interaction, update lead statuses, and manage your pipeline perfectly. We use Zoho CRM; you do not need to know it beforehand, but you must be a fast learner who is eager to master it during onboarding.



Precision Checklist Execution (Priority 2): In between handling instant lead responses, you will execute daily, weekly, and monthly internal administrative checklists exactly as documented.



Proactive Daily Reporting: Confirm all daily lead metrics and admin tasks are completed via a transparent daily reporting system before you log off.Facility & Operations Monitoring: Remotely monitor the clinic’s physical operations by reviewing uploaded site photos, analyzing operational data, and checking remote camera feeds.



Internal Staff Communication: Act as a professional coordinator between the Owner and our local, US-based clinic staff.



Strict Requirements

True Bilingual Fluency: Flawless, professional, and clear verbal and written communication in both English and Spanish. You must be comfortable handling sales objections over the phone in both languages.



Tech Savvy & Coachable: While Zoho CRM experience is not required, you must demonstrate a strong willingness and ability to learn new software platforms quickly.



High Urgency & Speed: You thrive in a fast-paced environment where a medical lead must be called within minutes of submission.



Rock-Solid Infrastructure (Non-Negotiable): A reliable PC/laptop, a fast internet connection, a quiet workspace for phone calls, and a robust power backup system (UPS/Solar) to ensure zero downtime.Stable & Routine-Loving: You must enjoy structured, high-compliance work and seek long-term job stability.



Compensation & Growth PathThis is a premium, long-term contract role designed to reward elite reliability and execution:

Training/Onboarding Phase: $9.00 / hour (Part-time hours while you master our intake scripts, workflows, and Zoho CRM setup).

3-Month Operations Milestone: $10.00 / hour (Scaling up to a consistent 40 hours/week once training and lead response speed benchmarks are successfully met).

1-Year Loyalty Increase: $11.00 / hour (After 1 full year of consistent, zero-reminder execution).



How to Apply (Strict Application Instructions)

To protect our time, we only review applications that follow instructions perfectly. Please submit your proposal with the following:



A working link to a short video (2 to 3 minutes) of yourself. Please upload this to a secure cloud link (Google Drive, Dropbox, Loom) or as an unlisted YouTube video. First half of the video (in English): Introduce yourself, state where you are based, and describe your experience learning new software or CRM systems quickly. How do you ensure you never forget a recurring daily task without needing reminders? A screenshot of your current internet speed test (from Speedtest.net).Confirm the specific power backup system (UPS or Solar) you possess to handle local power grid fluctuations.



Include the phrase "Zero Reminders" at the very top of your application. If this phrase is missing, your video link does not work, or you do not speak Spanish in the video, your application will be automatically archived.

title: Creative Operations Manager - E-commerce
description:
Want to run a creative department end to end? Join us as our Creative Operations Manager and take full ownership of the team, the dashboard, and the output of a fast-growing e-commerce brand.



We’re a fast-growing e-commerce company hiring a Creative Operations Manager to run our creative department, including video editors, graphic designers, and copywriters.



You are not here to make the creative. You are here to make the creative machine run: capacity, output, deadlines, systems, and people.



This is a leadership role. You will be trusted to own outcomes, not micromanaged on tasks. If you prefer a task-only execution role, this is not for you.



This role lives in the numbers. You’ll own our creative dashboard entirely, and at any 
nt, you’ll know who has room for more work, who is overloaded, and what is at risk of slipping before anyone asks.



You don’t manage from a distance. You catch problems early, confront underperformance directly, and make difficult people decisions with confidence.



Full ownership is the goal. This role is measured by one thing: how efficiently you scale creative output without sacrificing quality.



What You’ll Own



The Dashboard and Capacity Planning



* Own the creative operations dashboard, including capacity, utilization, deadlines, and workload.

* Track output per editor and per project. Spot bottlenecks before they affect production.

* Forecast production and hiring needs weekly and monthly.

* Bring leadership data-backed recommendations, not opinions.

* When a number drops, find the leak and put a fix in place.



The Team



* Directly manage the video editing team, with copywriters and other creative tea
mbers in scope when needed.

* Run interviews and assess talent effectively. Hiring is a core part of this role.

* Run one-on-ones and performance reviews.

* Hold people accountable. When someone underperforms, identify the problem, set a clear improvement plan with a deadline, and make the final call if they do not meet expectations.



Process, Systems, and AI



* Audit and rebuild outdated workflows and SOPs across the creative pipeline.

* Ensure every project has an owner, a deadline, and a clear status.

* Use AI daily to multiply output through SOP creation, data analysis, automation, reporting, and forecasting.

* Grow production capacity without automatically growing headcount.

* Work confidently with spreadsheets and automation tools.

* Keep individual contributors, managers, and leadership aligned so production never stops.



Before You Apply



We want to be transparent and respectful of everyone’s time.



This is a senior management position, not an assistant, coordinator, specialist, or first-time leadership role. To be considered, you must have at least three years of direct experience in both e-commerce and operations management, including experience working specifically as an Operations Manager or in a genuinely equivalent management position.



Experience as an assistant, team lead, project coordinator, or individual contributor will not meet the requirements for this role unless you also have the required Operations Manager experience.



Applications that do not clearly demonstrate at least three years of relevant e-commerce operations management experience will be automatically disqualified. Please apply only if your background matches this requirement.



Must-Haves



* At least three years of direct experience as an Operations Manager or in an equivalent management role within e-commerce.

* Experience managing teams, ideally creative, production, or operational teams.

* Highly analytical and obsessed with numbers. Capacity planning, utilization, and performance metrics are your comfort zone.

* A direct communicator who does not avoid conflict. You address problems head-on and do not let issues sit.

* Comfortable making difficult people decisions, including terminations, with proven experience doing so.

* Proven experience running structured interviews and making hiring decisions.

* Strong data skills. You are highly capable with spreadsheets and understand when to use a median instead of an average.

* Technical enough to work with automation tools, scripts, and developers, and able to learn new software quickly.

* Heavy, hands-on use of AI in daily operations work. You can clearly explain which tools you use, how you use them, and why.

* Extremely organized and process-oriented. Nothing sits, nothing waits, and you always know who is stuck and what is blocking them.

* Strong written and spoken English. You will run meetings, hold people accountable, and write SOPs.

* Daily availability from 1 PM to 10 PM Manila time, GMT+8, with reasonable availability when urgent issues arise.



Nice-to-Haves



* Experience managing video editors, designers, copywriters, or other creative production teams at scale.

* Experience building or owning a capacity, utilization, or KPI dashboard.

* Strong experience with ClickUp, Notion, Airtable, 
, or similar tools.

* Experience building AI workflows or automations.

* A basic understanding of video production workflows. You do not need to edit, but you need to understand what “done” and “good” look like.



Our Hiring Process



We move quickly while respecting your time.



1. Fill out our quick application form. It includes simple questions and takes around five minutes.

2. We respond to every applicant. No ghosting.

3. Qualified applicants complete a short first interview focused on experience and culture fit.

4. Those who pass complete a short technical interview.

5. Crush it, and we send you an offer.



What You’ll Receive After Going Full-Time



Following a successful one-to-two-month probation period, you’ll receive:



* A salary increase above your starting pay

* 13th-month pay

* 18 days of paid time off, plus holidays

* Every AI tool you need, paid for by us

* Health insurance

* An annual training and learning budget

* The opportunity to fly out and meet the rest of the team, completely optional



We genuinely take care of our team and invest heavily in our people. We’re looking for someone who wants to take ownership, grow with us, and build something meaningful for the long term.



One final note before you apply: this is a senior Operations Manager role. You must have at least three years of direct experience in both e-commerce and operations management. Assistant, coordinator, team lead, or individual contributor experience alone will not qualify. Applications that do not clearly meet these requirements will be automatically disqualified.



If your experience matches, we would genuinely love to hear from you.



Apply now. It takes five minutes.

title: Video Editor & YouTube/Social Publisher — Faceless Story Channel (CapCut) — Long-Term, Part-Time
description:
Job Description: I run a faceless YouTube storytelling channel. All the creative assets — script, voiceover, and images — are produced for you and handed over in an organized pack. Your job is to assemble them into finished videos in CapCut and upload them to YouTube for my review. This is repetitive, template-based work with clear step-by-step instructions. If you're reliable and detail-oriented, this becomes steady long-term work with room to grow as the channel scales to daily posting.



What you'll do:



Download a provided asset pack (numbered images + voiceover clips) from a shared source.

Assemble them in CapCut using my exact template: images over voiceover, gentle auto-zoom, auto-captions (white text), a background music track, intro and end cards.

Export in 1080p and upload to YouTube as a Private draft with the title, description, and thumbnail I provide — then notify me for final review. I approve and publish; you never publish publicly yourself.

Cut the short vertical clips (Shorts) that go with each video, and post them natively to YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and
.

Keep a simple tracking sheet updated (what's assembled, uploaded, and posted).



Big plus if you have it: experience growing TikTok / Reels / Shorts accounts (trending audio, hashtags, hooks, posting times). We cross-post to all short-form platforms to drive traffic back to YouTube, so short-form distribution skill is genuinely valuable here.



Requirements:



Solid CapCut experience (or Premiere/DaVinci) — especially captions, Ken Burns zoom, and audio syncing.

Strong English for accurate captions and titles.

Familiar with YouTube Studio (uploading, thumbnails, scheduling, Shorts).

Detail-oriented, follows a checklist exactly, meets daily deadlines.

Reliable internet and availability to deliver on a consistent schedule.



Nice to have: thumbnail design, basic sound mixing, experience with faceless/story channels.



Hours & Pay: Start part-time (~10+ hrs/week), scaling toward daily as we grow. State your monthly rate for part-time. (Budget guide: competitive OnlineJobs.ph part-time rate; per-video bonus possible as volume increases.)



To apply — do this or I skip your application:



Reply with the word QUIET at the top so I know you read this.

Link 1–2 examples of videos you've edited (CapCut or similar).

One sentence: how fast could you assemble a 10-minute image-and-voiceover video with captions once you know the template?

- Quick wins shipped: schema fixes, internal linking improvements, attribute completeness for top SKUs/collections, and one entity-driven content hub launched.

- GEO scorecard established (priority queries, inclusion/citation rate, answer snippets captured, supporting pages).

- Material growth in non-brand organic revenue and category rankings.

- Sustained inclusion/citation in AI answers for target queries across core categories.

- Repeatable GEO playbook embedded in content and merchandising workflows.

- Proven SEO chops in eCommerce (preferably Shopify) with measurable revenue impact.

- Hands-on GEO experience (or a strong POV) optimizing for AI Overviews and answer engines: structuring content for direct answers, citations, and entity confidence.

- Proficiency with Ahrefs/Similar, Google Search Console, GA4, and Shopify; comfort with HTML/Liquid basics and JSON-LD.

- Ability to plan and execute on-brand digital PR/backlink programs.

- Strong analytical skills; can turn data into decisions and roadmaps.

title: QA Specialist
description:
You will be the last set of eyes before anything reaches a client. If it's not good enough, it doesn't go out.



You will be the last set of eyes before anything reaches a client. If it's not good enough, it doesn't go out.

We make ads that don't feel like ads.



PodcastADS is a UGC ad production company. We create short-form video ads for brands — the kind that

look like real conversations between real people, not polished commercials. Our clients run these on Meta,

TikTok, and YouTube, and they perform because they feel human.



We work fast, we care about quality, and we hold a very high bar for what goes out the door. That's where

you come in.



THE ROLE

You are the quality gate.



As a QA Specialist at PodcastADS, your job is to review scripts and finished videos before they reach clients

— and make sure nothing slips through. You'll be the last set of eyes on every piece of content we produce,

and your standards become our standards.



This isn't a passive role. We need someone who catches issues others miss, communicates feedback

clearly and specifically, and genuinely cares whether a video feels real or feels like an ad.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Script QA

• Review scripts written by copywriters

before they go to production

• Flag AI-language, unnatural phrasing,

and compliance violations

• Check hooks, CTAs, length, and

formatting against brand briefs

• Leave clear, actionable comments with

specific fixes



Video QA

• Apply the 5-Pass QA method to every

finished video

• Review acting naturalness, b-roll

relevance, subtitle accuracy

• Check pacing, fluff, music levels, lip

sync, and technical issues

• Leave timestamped feedback on


 for editors



Raw Footage Review

• Review raw footage to identify the best

and most natural takes

• Timestamp approved clips so editors

know exactly what to use

• Note off-script takes, backup options, and

anything substandard

Communication & Standards

• Communicate feedback to editors,

copywriters, and clients professionally

• Hold the quality line even under deadline

pressure

• Help maintain and improve internal QA

standards over time



WHAT 'GOOD' LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE

?You watch a video and immediately feel when something is 'off' — even before you can

articulate why

?You know the difference between a line that sounds natural and a line that sounds like it was

written by ChatGPT

?Your feedback is specific: not 'this feels unnatural' but 'at 0:42 the actor pauses to read their

phone — swap for take 2'

?You don't approve something just because a deadline is close — you flag it and propose a

solution

?You can handle a client pushing back on your notes and hold your position calmly and

professionally

? You watch our top-performing ads and understand exactly why they worked



YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF...

You have:

• A sharp eye for performance and

naturalness in video

Bonus if you have:

• Background in video production, casting,

or creative direction

• Experience reviewing or editing

short-form video content (UGC, ads,

social)

• Strong written communication — your

notes are clear, not vague

• Comfort working with tools like


, Google Docs, and Notion

• The ability to manage your own time

and hit turnaround windows

• Genuine pride in quality — you care

that the work is good

• Experience working with UGC creators or

performance ad agencies

• Familiarity with Meta Ads or TikTok ad

formats

• An understanding of what makes a

scroll-stopping hook

• Experience in copywriting or script review



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF...

? You approve content just to get it off your plate

? You give vague feedback that editors can't act on

? You can't handle direct conversations about quality

? You think 'it's mostly fine' is good enough

? You need constant hand-holding to know what needs fixing

? You confuse 'polished' with 'natural' — they are not the same thing



THE STANDARD WE HOLD

Natural beats polished. Every time.



Every video we produce needs to feel like a candid conversation — the kind people actually have. Not a

sales pitch. Not a script. A real 
nt between two people, one of whom happens to know about a

product.



When you QA our work, you are protecting that standard. If a line sounds like it was written by AI, it gets

fixed. If an actor is clearly reading their phone, the take gets swapped. If b-roll doesn't match the story, it

gets replaced.



We watch every piece of content at least five times before it leaves us. That's not obsessive — that's the job.

title: Chief of Staff and Personal Assistant
description:
Who am I?



I'm Braden Wallake. I run a LinkedIn marketing agency, a SaaS company, and I just bought a boutique hotel in Mexico. I travel constantly, I play hard, and I move fast.



I have a lot going on. And I love it.



I'm not looking to slow down. I'm looking for someone who can keep up.



---



The Role



This isn't a typical assistant job. It's not scoped to one company or one to-do list. It's built around me and what I need to do my best work across everything I have going on.



Your job is simple in theory: make my life easier, make things happen, and help me show up great at everything I do.



In practice, that means you're the person holding everything together. You see what needs to happen before I do. You take the voice memo I sent at 11pm and turn it into something real. You turn a messy week into a clean one. You take my ideas and run with them.



---



What You'll Help With



No two weeks look the same. On any given week you might be:



- Taking an idea I texted at 11pm and turning it into a finished deliverable

- Writing a blog post for one business and a marketing
 for another

- Coordinating with hotel staff in Mexico on a guest experience

- Booking flights and building travel itineraries

- Tracking down vendors, getting quotes, and coming back with a clear recommendation

- Managing timelines and deliverables across multiple businesses

- Helping me stay on top of personal finances and investments

- Figuring out what I'm spending time on that I shouldn't be, and handling it



There's no perfect job description for this because the role is my life. And my life doesn't fit in a box.



---



Who Thrives Here



You love figuring things out. You see a mess and want to organize it. You don't wait to be told what to do, you just handle it.



You write well and communicate clearly. You can send an
 as me and it sounds like me. You can talk to a contractor, a business partner, or a hotel vendor and represent me the right way.



You come back with answers, not just options. You make a call, move forward, and keep me in the loop without creating more noise.



You're someone people can trust. When something is yours, it gets done.



---



What Success Looks Like



Six months in, I'm not thinking about the things you're handling. I'm focused on the stuff only I can do.



A year in, you know how I think. You're solving problems I haven't even noticed yet. My businesses run better, my personal life runs smoother, and I'm showing up as the best version of myself across all of it.



That's the goal.



---



What I'm Looking For



- Experience supporting a founder, executive, or entrepreneur in a real, high trust capacity

- Strong organization and follow through

- Great writing and communication skills

- Comfortable juggling multiple businesses and priorities at once

- Good judgment and the confidence to use it

- Familiarity with tools like ClickUp, LinkedIn, or
 marketing platforms is a plus

- Bonus points if you have experience with B2B and/or hospitality. 



---



Position Details



- Full time preferres

- Remote with occasional travel

- Pay is competitive and based on experience



---



To Apply



No generic cover letters. Think about it and craft a proposal to why you’re a good fit.



In it, answer these 3 questions.



1. The most complex thing you've managed on behalf of someone else and how you handled it

2. What a great week looks like to you in a role like this

3. One thing you'd tell a busy founder they're probably doing that they shouldn't be

Qualifications

Performance Expectations

• Maintain accurate and timely CRM documentation.

• Deliver a professional and engaging customer experience during every interaction.

    * Hook writing

    * Script writing

    * Storytelling

    * Consumer psychology

    * Buyer psychology

    * Sales psychology

    * Attention economics

    * Calls-to-action that convert

* Understand what drives engagement, watch time, shares, saves, and sales.

* Able to write naturally for AI influencer and creator-style brands.

* Can consistently generate original ideas without relying on AI to do the thinking.

* Strong research skills with the ability to identify trends before they become mainstream.

* Knows how to repurpose and reframe successful content into something unique.

* Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.

* Self-motivated and able to work independently.

* Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly.



What We’re NOT Looking For



* Someone who simply prompts Claude or ChatGPT and copies the output.

* Generic copywriters with little understanding of social media.

* Writers who rely on AI to do all the thinking.

* People who chase trends without understanding strategy.

* Anyone with weak written or spoken English.



Bonus Skills



* Experience growing creator or business accounts.

* Proven examples of high-performing social media content.

* Experience writing for coaching, education, SaaS, AI, or digital products.

* Understanding of AI influencers and faceless content brands.

* Familiarity with social media analytics, retention metrics, watch time, CTR, and conversion optimization.

* Experience A/B testing hooks, captions, scripts, and messaging.



To Apply



Resumes are not required. We’re far more interested in your ability than your employment history.



Please include:



* Examples of your best hooks, captions, and scripts.

* Links to any social media accounts you’ve helped grow (if applicable).

* Examples of content you’re most proud of.

* A brief explanation of how you research trends and identify viral opportunities.

* Tell us what you believe separates content that gets views from content that generates sales.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a small paid test assignment to evaluate your content research, copywriting, hook writing, scripting, and creative thinking. We hire based on skill—not résumés.



If you’re someone who understands the psychology behind viral content, can consistently produce original ideas, and knows how to turn attention into revenue, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Social Media Manager/Creatives
description:
KLIK is a DTC ecommerce brand built around the KLIK Camera — a screen-free digital camera designed to bring back the feel of 90s film photography without the film rolls. No preview screen, no camera roll. You shoot, stay present, and transfer photos via USB-C later. 4 built-in film-emulation filters, 500 shots per charge, 95g, available in 7 colors.



Rated 4.8/5 across nearly 1,000 customer reviews, sold globally at 
. The brand targets people who want to disconnect from screens and capture real 
nts — trips, parties, weddings, festivals, everyday life.



You can check out our account 
 on Instagram



About the Role

We are looking for a Social Media Manager & Creative to own and grow KLIK’s social presence across channels. This is not just a scheduling role — it’s a creative leadership position. You’ll build real channel strategies, manage our accounts, curate and post UGC content, and contribute to broader brand creative work.



We have a team to support the editing for simple Instagram posts, which is handled within this role. Beyond social media, this is an overall creative role where we’d love to do more brand work.



What You’ll Do

Manage the accounts

Keep track of all KLIK social media accounts. Curate and filter the UGC posts we currently have, post them, and give credit where credit is due. Maintain a consistent posting schedule across all active platforms.



Build channel strategies

Create a real social strategy for each platform:

Instagram — primary platform, full strategy (can be combined with
 cross-posting)

 — not a priority, we simply cross-post from Instagram

Pinterest — dedicated strategy

TikTok — dedicated strategy



Create

Beyond social media management, this is an overall creative role. We’d love to do more brand work — visual identity work, creative campaigns, brand storytelling, and original content that captures the authentic, nostalgic KLIK aesthetic.



Full Responsibilities

Manage all KLIK social media accounts — Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, and

Curate and filter UGC content from the existing library, post and credit creators appropriately

Develop and execute dedicated channel strategies for Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest

Create, plan, and manage a consistent content calendar across all platforms

Produce or oversee simple Instagram post edits (editing support team available)

Write compelling captions, hooks, and copy that match the KLIK brand voice

Monitor and respond to comments, DMs, and community engagement

Track and report on social media performance metrics — reach, engagement, follower growth, saves

Stay updated on social media trends, platform algorithm changes, and competitor activity

Contribute to broader brand creative work — campaigns, visual identity, and storytelling

Collaborate with Video Editors, Creative Strategists, and the wider marketing team



Must-have

Proven experience managing social media accounts for a DTC or ecommerce brand

Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest — what works, what doesn’t, and why

Experience building social media channel strategies from scratch, not just scheduling posts

Strong eye for visual content, brand aesthetics, and UGC curation

Excellent copywriting skills — captions, hooks, and brand voice

Comfortable working independently and managing your own content calendar

Organized, reliable, and data-aware — tracks performance and adjusts strategy accordingly

Own device and stable internet connection



Nice-to-have

Experience with nostalgic, lifestyle, or film-aesthetic brand content

Basic graphic design or video editing skills for simple social assets

Familiarity with social scheduling tools (Later, Buffer, Planoly, or similar)

Experience managing or growing a brand account from early stage

Understanding of UGC creator communities and how to engage and credit them



KLIK Brand Aesthetic — What to Keep in Mind

The KLIK social presence should feel:

Authentic and real — not over-produced or overly polished

Nostalgic and film-like — vintage tones, grain, candid 
nts

Community-driven — UGC is at the heart of the content

Lifestyle-first — trips, parties, everyday life, human connection

Emotionally resonant — content that makes people want to pick up a camera

Think: someone at a festival pulls out a KLIK, shoots without looking at the screen, and the photos come out beautifully imperfect. That feeling is what the feed should communicate.



Hiring Process

Portfolio Review - Review of social media work, brand accounts managed, and content examples

Paid Creative Test - Build a sample content calendar or channel strategy for KLIK — 100% original work paid, with $25 payment through WISE.

Initial Interview - Background, experience, and creative approach discussion

Trial Period/1-Month Evaluation -  Part-time or direct hire depending on test outcome. Full output and performance evaluation over one month

Full-Time Offer - Hire confirmed — or engagement ends



?  The creative test is mandatory. After the 1-month evaluation, the engagement either moves to full-time or ends — no ambiguity.

title: HIRING: VIDEO EDITOR (FULL-TIME)
description:
Hey — I’m Karos. I’m 17, and I’m running a 7-figure e-commerce brand. This is not a corporate, LinkedIn-style job post. No fluff. No buzzwords. No BS. I’m looking for a full-time Video Editor who understands direct response and actually cares about performance. This is not a “just cut clips together” role. This is about making ads that perform.



I’m building fast and I’m obsessed with results. This is only the beginning. If you join now, you’re not just editing videos — you’re growing with me, long-term. This is NOT a short-term gig. It’s a chance to build something real together.



What you’ll be doing:

Editing direct-response video ads (Meta-focused)

Creating high-converting ads, not just aesthetic edits

Producing 3 hooks per video

Turning our raw ideas + strategy into scroll-stopping creatives

Using AI tools like ElevenLabs and AI Personas where it makes sense

Iterating based on performance data

Working directly with me — fast feedback, fast decisions

Helping push the brand from “doing well” to dominating



VERY Highly valued skill:

- AI: Experience with tools like HeyGen, Google Veo, Kling, Nano Banana

Candidates with this skill set will have a strong advantage.



Who I’m looking for:

You’ve edited direct-response ads for e-commerce brands

You understand performance, not just visuals

You have a STRONG EYE for details

You’re fast, disciplined, and competitive

You care about results and high standards

You want to work exclusively on one brand and help grow it

If you want something slow, safe, and corporate — this isn’t for you.



Compensation:

Full-time, remote role

Base salary depends on experience and skill

Performance-based bonuses tied directly to ad results

For strong performers, monthly bonuses can realistically reach around $1,000, depending on output and performance. There’s no fixed cap — results drive upside. If you make winning ads, you make more money. When the brand wins, you win.



The Big opportunity:

This starts as a Video Editor role, but there’s room to grow. If you consistently deliver, understand what’s working, and show good judgment over time, you can move into a better role with more responsibility and higher pay. I’m building brands for the long run and looking for people who want stability, ownership, and multi-year collaboration, not constant job hopping.



Application process (important):

To filter unserious applicants, please fill out this form:




Once you have submitted I will have a look and get back to you ASAP

Speak soon, Karos

title: Sales and Booking Specialist - Plumbing Company (USA Hours)
description:
Barbour Plumbing is a fast-growing, family-owned plumbing company serving Tampa Bay, Florida. We need a sharp, experienced call center professional to answer inbound calls, book appointments, and work outbound prospect lists to keep our technicians' schedules full.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE — not customer service. We need someone who loves the phone and takes pride in hitting numbers.



Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (strict — no exceptions) Start: ASAP



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Inbound: Answer every call. Qualify the customer. Book the appointment in Housecall Pro. Pitch our membership plan on every call.



Outbound: Work skip-traced homeowner lists. Follow up on missed calls and web leads within 5 minutes. Reactivate past customers via phone.



Confirmations: Call every appointment 24 hours ahead. Reschedule cancellations same day. Zero empty slots.



Reporting: Log every call in our CRM. Send an end-of-day summary to management daily.



REQUIREMENTS — NON-NEGOTIABLE



Minimum 2 years call center experience — inbound AND outbound Fluent, clear spoken English (Tampa Bay homeowners must understand you on the first call) Experience with dialer systems (Five9, RingCentral, VICI, Avaya, or similar) Experience working cold lists or skip-traced data Fiber internet (25 Mbps+), quality USB headset, quiet dedicated workspace Available 8am–5pm Eastern Time, Monday–Friday — no flexibility



PREFERRED (BONUS)



Experience with Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, or Jobber Home services background (plumbing, HVAC, electrical, pest control) Experience selling service memberships or maintenance agreements Bilingual English/Spanish



NOT A FIT IF: You have only done chat or
 support You have never worked a cold list or outbound campaign



TRAINING PROVIDED Housecall Pro system (full 1-week walkthrough) Call scripts, objection handling, membership pitch



COMPENSATION Base: $6–$8/hr USD (based on verifiable call center experience) Booking bonus: $10–$15 per completed appointment Membership bonus: $25–$40 per plan sold Upsell commission: 2–3% (capped at $75) Monthly performance bonus: $100–$200



Top performers earn $1,200–$1,800/month USD total.



HOW TO APPLY
 
 with subject: Barbour Plumbing Sales VA — [Your Name]



Include:



Resume (PDF) showing call center experience with dates and employer names

A 60–90 second voice recording — introduce yourself and explain why you are right for a cold outbound role (Loom or Google Drive link)

Available start date and current time zone

No voice recording = automatic decline.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Marketing Coordinator

Experience: 5 Years ( Part-Time to  Full-Time)

Apply To: 

Agency Overview

Hughes Media is a growing independent, full-service digital marketing agency based in Atlanta, GA. We provide best-in-class marketing and creative execution. We’re passionate about our clients and our growing team, and we are looking for a dynamic Marketing Coordinator to help drive our continued growth.

The Role

The Marketing Coordinator collaborates with the Account Service team and agency partners on the development and execution of all marketing campaigns. The ideal candidate thrives in a high-energy, fast-paced environment, possesses exceptional organizational skills, and brings a proactive, "can-do" attitude to every project.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership

Campaign Support: Assist the team in daily deliverables, activities, budgets, and deadlines for creative campaigns and individual client projects.

Project Lifecycle: Coordinate or participate in any phase of the project cycle—including planning, design, development, testing, implementation, and closure.

Efficiency: Ensure orderly and timely completion of work, adhering to all agency processes and procedures.

Documentation: Facilitate all administrative duties including weekly status reports, project documentation, and internal job management (including conference reports within 24 hours of meetings).

Meeting Execution: Coordinate and execute internal, partner, and client meetings (e.g., Creative kickoffs, brand immersions, and project post-mortems).

Accountability: Manage small projects as assigned and maintain accurate daily timesheets.

Marketing & Client Relations

Brand Growth: Strengthen client relationships by gaining a deep understanding of their industry, products, and competition.

Industry Trends: Maintain a base understanding of advertising, digital, and media trends to present business-building ideas.

Performance Tracking: Support the team with metrics and program performance measures to evaluate effectiveness and inform future initiatives.

Skills & Abilities

Education: Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) from a four-year college or university (preferably in Marketing, Advertising, or a related field).

Communication: Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing.

Work Ethic: Results-oriented, self-motivated, and able to balance multiple priorities with strict attention to detail.

Collaboration: Ability to work both independently and as a vital part of a team.

Technical: Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word is required.

Experience Requirements

Functional Expertise: 4-5 years within an Agency or in-house Marketing environment (combined part-time and full-time experience is accepted).

Project Management: 4-3 years of experience coordinating marketing workflows and timelines.

title: Order Management Specialist
description:
TO APPLY

If this opportunity feels like the perfect fit for you and you meet the job qualifications, we invite you to learn more about our HiEnd Accents team in the Philippines and submit your application here:

airtable(dot)com/appzq4iqeIREQRVyo/pagZk1jvydfqYXGy9/form NOTE: Change the word "(dot)" to an actual dot.







Applications submitted through onlinejobs.ph will not be reviewed. We look forward to reviewing your application.



TO BE RESPECTFUL OF YOUR TIME, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DO NOT MEET THE JOB REQUIREMENTS. We evaluate against these requirements strictly. If you do not have the requisite experience, please do not apply.



JOB DESCRIPTION



We are looking for an energetic and detail-oriented individual with extensive experience managing customer order flow to join our growing team. As an Order Management Specialist, you will be responsible for processing customer orders and coordinating fulfillment logistics. The ultimate goal is to ensure that customer orders are processed efficiently, accurately and on-time.



As an Order Management Specialist, you will work as a member of our company’s Operations team. To be successful at the role, the ideal candidate must have strong customer service, communication and interpersonal skills. You will work closely with our internal team and our customers (via
 and phone) to fulfill their orders. You can expect to learn a lot about how our business functions, be professionally challenged and have plenty of opportunities for career development!



We are looking for long-term tea
mbers who will stay and grow at our company! Please apply if you have full-time availability and can commit to a long-term, mutually beneficial role.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Bring in customer orders daily from various sources, including customer portals, EDI,
s and faxes

- Respond to incoming
s and phone calls with same-day service

- Confirm purchase order changes and make changes to orders in our ERP system

- Maintain accurate documentation of all actions/conversations/issues (through Front and Airtable)

- Release orders/backorders for shipping in a timely fashion

- Organize order releasing for easy picking and communicate with our Warehouse team for shipment alignment

- Create delivery slips and invoice shipped orders

- Upload/enter shipping and invoicing information to customer portals

- Create, send inventory, shipping and invoicing EDI documents

- Handle payment issues, solve order-related problems and interact with account managers as needed

- Interact with customers and provide them with information on order-related questions (such as inventory availability) and product inquiries

- Understand and ensure departmental KPIs, objectives, and guidelines are followed

- Ensure customer SLAs are followed

- Work on other duties as assigned



WHO YOU ARE

- A Bachelor's Degree

- 1-3 years experience with order management, data entry and customer service

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills; additionally, strong interpersonal skills, particularly in a customer-facing capacity

- EDI experience

- Excellent attention to detail

- Strong organizational skills; self-motivated and proactive

- MS Excel ability

- Excellent English skills

- Ability to work with our US team via
, Slack and Zoom. Highly preferred, but not required: experience with Airtable and Notion

- Positive, kind and easy to work with

- A team player mentality - one team, one dream!

- Positive and kind

- A desire to learn and grow within our organization

- Willingness to learn and adopt new tools

- Reliable and detailed-oriented

- Stable, trustworthy highly dependable. Ideally someone seeking a long-term relationship where we can both grow from the relationship



HOURS

Fixed Schedule, M-F, US Central Time



ABOUT HIEND ACCENTS

HiEnd Accents creates designer bedding and home decor. Founded by a husband-wife team in 2005, we remain a family business today. Our customers love our unique designs across a wide range of styles, everyday luxury pricing and commitment to excellent service. We sell on both a wholesale as well as retail basis and are based in Irving, TX.



WHY HIEND ACCENTS?

Our small size and fast-paced culture reward people who act and think like owners. If you're someone who has a growth mentality, strives for exceptionalism, are a committed professional and a straight shooter, you’ll fit in with our culture and go far with our company.



Working at HiEnd Accents means that you can expect the following:

- Competitive Compensation - We offer a highly competitive compensation package, including 13th Month Pay

- Professional Growth - We invest in our people and make sure that they have the opportunity to continuously learn, grow and develop their careers

- Great Team of Like-Minded Professionals - We prioritize hiring based on culture and values, so you’re working with a team of folks who are as fun, talented and committed as you are

title: Account Manager
description:
Full-Time Account Manager



Full Time. Long Term, Remote | Philippines-based | 40 hours per week

$10–$15 USD per hour plus performance bonuses



ABOUT VTC



Views To Clients helps B2B founders, SaaS companies and leading brands build profitable YouTube channels.



We started 2026 at approximately $100,000 per month and have since grown to around $500,000 per month. Our target is to reach $1 million per month by the end of 2026.



Our clients and work include names such as Gary Vee, ManyChat, Instantly AI and Glencoco. We have helped build some of the leading business channels in their niches, generating millions of views, subscribers and attributable revenue.



Our mission is to become undeniably and irrefutably the best team of experts for building profitable business YouTube channels. We now need exceptional people who can make sure every client receives the standard of service, execution and care that this mission requires.



THE ROLE



We are hiring a full-time Account Manager to own a portfolio of clients and make sure every client gets exactly what they need, when they need it.



This is not a support-only role and it is not a passive project-management role. You will personally communicate with clients, protect their experience, coordinate delivery across the team, resolve problems and drive accounts towards retention, growth and measurable success.



Strong account management alone is not enough. You must also be highly capable in project management, operations, client communication, commercial judgement and team coordination.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



• Make sure clients are onboarded at the correct pace and remain actively engaged

• Ensure weekly client deliverables are completed on time and to the expected standard

• Respond to or coordinate the resolution of client queries within our two-working-hour SLA

• Maintain clear visibility across every client, project, owner, deadline and risk

• Identify delivery or relationship risks before they become client problems

• Coordinate strategy, scripting, editing, thumbnails and other delivery functions

• Chase missing actions, remove blockers and follow issues through to confirmed closure

• Personally handle client communication, complaints, difficult conversations and recovery

• Protect retention and identify appropriate opportunities for upsells, cross-sells and referrals

• Generate positive reviews, testimonials and case studies through excellent client outcomes

• Keep client and project-management systems accurate and current

• Escalate anything that requires wider operational, leadership or commercial support

• When a client is at churn risk, lead the best possible save or manage a clean, relationship-preserving offboarding



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Your ultimate outcomes are strong gross revenue retention, logo retention, net revenue retention and client satisfaction.



The leading measures you will influence include:



• Client On-time Delivery Rate

• Client Query Resolution Time

• Client Engagement Rate

• Number of client complaints

• Onboarding speed and client health

• Upsells, cross-sells and referrals

• Positive reviews, testimonials and case studies



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should have:



• Proven customer success or account-management experience in a complex client-service business

• Strong project-management and operational ability across multiple clients and workstreams

• Excellent written communication and confidence speaking with clients on calls

• Experience resolving complaints, protecting relationships and recovering accounts at risk

• Commercial judgement around retention, expansion and long-term client value

• The ability to hold internal owners accountable while keeping relationships constructive

• Strong prioritisation, attention to detail and follow-through

• The judgement to distinguish credible progress from optimistic reporting

• A proactive ownership mindset: you drive problems to a safe outcome rather than merely reporting them

• Confidence improving an imperfect system while still operating it effectively



Agency, SaaS, creative-production or other high-touch recurring-service experience is strongly preferred.



COMPENSATION



$10–$15 USD per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



Performance bonuses will be available for strong client-retention, satisfaction and operational results. There is significant room for increased responsibility and compensation as VTC grows.



HOW TO APPLY



Complete this mandatory application form. Do not apply through OnlineJobs.ph alone:







The application includes a short Loom video covering your experience, a difficult client situation you have owned and how you would keep multiple clients successful and on track.



Applications submitted without the form and Loom video will be automatically rejected.



VERIFY VTC

Website: 

Founder: 

UK company: Views To Clients Ltd, company number
Companies House:
