title: Amazon Ops VA - EU Marketplaces (FR/ES/DE/IT) - AI-assisted, part-time
description:
We are a French e-commerce company selling home & garden products under our own brand on Amazon EU (France, Spain, Germany, Italy - FBA, ~800k EUR/year). We run a modern, AI-assisted operation: our AI agent monitors the account daily and drafts replies, Seller Support cases and reports in all four local languages. YOUR ROLE is to be the human in the loop - review, validate, click, escalate. This is NOT a "do everything manually" role.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Review AI-drafted replies to customer messages (Amazon Buyer Messages + our HubSpot inbox) and send them after checking accuracy and tone

- Handle warranty claims for our garden hose line: verify purchase date, apply our replacement/refund policy, process refunds and replacements up to 50 EUR per case (above that, escalate)

- Review AI-drafted Seller Support cases, submit them, track responses and follow up until resolution

- Handle routine issues: stranded inventory, suppressed listings, attribute conflicts, FBA reimbursements

- Act on the AI's daily account-health brief (posted in Slack each morning) and upload validated listing content

- Keep response time under 24h, 7 days a week (we care about SLA, not fixed hours)



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience (seller side): Buyer Messages, Seller Support case flow, FBA returns, Manage Inventory

- Amazon EU marketplace experience is a strong plus (VAT invoices, Pan-EU basics)

- Excellent written English (C1+). French/Spanish/German/Italian NOT required - our AI drafts in all four languages; you check structure and send

- Comfortable learning new tools fast: Slack, HubSpot, Sellerboard (we will train you)

- Reliable internet, own computer, at least 2-3h overlap with European mornings (CET)

- Meticulous: you read before you click. Blind approval of AI output is the one way to fail at this job



WE OFFER

- 5-8 USD/hr depending on experience, paid via Wise on time, 13th-month pay after 1 year

- Stable long-term role with a growing brand; clear playbook and AI tools that make you productive from week 1

- Direct access to the owner via Slack - no agency in between



HOW TO APPLY

Reply with:

1. 3-5 lines on a Seller Support case you personally resolved (what, how, outcome)

2. The word "hosepipe" somewhere in your reply so we know you read this far

3. Your expected hourly rate and weekly availability

Shortlisted candidates: 30-min video call + a short PAID test task (review 5 AI-drafted replies + 1 case).

description:

About the Role



We're looking for a **creative, proactive, and results-driven Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Specialist** to join our team. This isn't a typical recruiter role—we're looking for someone who knows how to **find great talent, not just wait for applications**.



As our in-house headhunter, you'll work directly with leadership to understand hiring needs, create compelling job postings, source candidates using creative strategies, conduct interviews, and manage the onboarding process from start to finish.

What You'll Do



* Partner with leadership to understand hiring requirements for each role.

* Source and headhunt top talent using creative recruitment strategies.

* Proactively reach out to potential candidates through LinkedIn, social media, referrals, and direct outreach.

* Screen and evaluate candidates based on company requirements.

* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers.

* Manage the hiring process from sourcing through onboarding.

* Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for future openings.

* Track recruitment metrics and continuously improve hiring strategies.

We're looking for someone who thinks beyond job boards.



For example, if we're hiring **Medi Spa Sales Professionals**, you might:

* Reach out to passive candidates through LinkedIn and professional communities.



If you see a great salesperson in action, we encourage you to introduce yourself and explore whether they'd be interested in joining our team.



Qualifications



* 2+ years of experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, or headhunting.

* Strong interviewing and candidate assessment skills.

* Excellent communication in English (written and verbal).

* Experience sourcing candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, and social media.

* Highly organized with strong follow-up skills.

* Self-motivated and able to work independently.

* Willing to do occasional local travel to source exceptional talent.

* Experience recruiting for sales, healthcare, hospitality, or customer-facing roles is an advantage.



What Success Looks Like



* Consistently hiring high-quality candidates.

* Building a strong pipeline of top talent.

* Using creative sourcing strategies to find candidates others miss.

* Delivering an excellent candidate experience from first contact through onboarding.

* Helping build high-performing teams that drive company growth.



Compensation & Benefits



* **USD $1,200/month**

* **Performance-based bonuses**

* Primarily **Work From Home**

* Occasional local travel for talent sourcing

* Opportunity to grow with a fast-growing international company

I’m looking for a super star in Social Media and Affiliate marketing who can join my company. Together we’ll work on amazing brands in the Netherlands and make them the most viral brands out there.

One of the best things: you can work mostly in the Philippine daytime, so no graveyard shift and sacrificing your night sleep, lol. And if results are met, I’ll give you a nice bonus every month.



This is a long-term role. We’ll start with 40 hours per week and if it’s a good match, I’d love to work together for years.

Depending on your experience, the monthly salary will be between $400–$500 for fulltime, paid on time every month.



Quickly about me

I have a Social Media Agency for over 6 years now and honestly, I’m one of the best in my country at what I do.?Currently I have several clients and it’s a bit much to do everything by myself.

In my time I’ve worked with multiple VAs who, after working with me, got better jobs because of what they learned while being with me. If you join, I want you to grow as well.



Experience I would love for you to have

* Social media experience – you’ve managed or helped manage Instagram/TikTok accounts, scheduled posts, done basic content research, or handled comments/DMs.

* Affiliate marketing experience – you’ve helped with influencer/affiliate outreach, built simple spreadsheets with affiliate data, or supported an affiliate program in any way.

* VA experience – things like online research, data entry, working with Google Sheets/Docs, sending outreach messages, and giving simple daily/weekly updates.



Personality (more important than experience)

Since I started as an entrepreneur, I only like to work with people I feel a good connection with. Your personality is equally or even more important than your experience.

* Happy person – I like people with a positive mental attitude. That’s the most important thing in succeeding.

* Reliable – the hours we agree to work are actually done, and you’re comfortable sharing a simple daily or weekly worksheet with what you worked on (no micromanagement, just clarity).

* Out of the box thinking – there is no “perfect” or “right/wrong” in a lot of cases; there is just something that needs to get done. I appreciate people who can think for themselves and suggest impactful ideas.



If you’re interested, here’s what I’d like to know

* In maximum 5 sentences, what is your work experience with social media and affiliate marketing?

* How is your life structured? In other words, what other commitments do you have that might interfere with work?

* If I would ask one of your best friends, your mom and your neighbour to list three of your best qualities, what would they say?

Start the header (subject line) with “I’m ready for this!”, so that I know you’ve read everything.

Please don’t write me a long, impersonal AI application. Every application will be put through AI and if it gets flagged as generic AI, I will not read it. Just be yourself and write like a real human.



I am looking for someone who wants to work only with me.

?This means:

* You do not have another job or client right now that takes your time during the week.

* You are not planning to combine this role with another client once we start working together.?I want you to be fully focused on this role and on growing together with me.



Looking forward to meeting you! I’ll try to respond within 1–2 days.

title: Paid Social Media Buyer (Meta/Google Ads)
description:
Do you live and breathe Meta Ads and Google Ads? Australia's leading fitness agency wants YOU to run the show.



ABOUT FITFAM

Fitfam is Australia's leading fitness creative and performance agency, based in Perth, WA. We work exclusively with fitness brands — gyms, studios, and ecommerce — running paid media on Meta and Google Ads. Our clients include some of Australia's most recognised fitness brands with 10+ active accounts across the country.

We're a small, tight-knit team. We move fast, we care about results, and we hold a high standard. The person in this role will work directly with our Founder and MD, and will be trusted to own paid advertising from day one.



JOB DESCRIPTION

We're looking for a full-time Paid Social Media Buyer to take complete ownership of our client ad accounts on Meta and Google Ads. This is not a support role — you'll be the person running the accounts, making decisions, managing budgets, testing creatives, and reporting results to clients.



YOUR DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES



Send a daily report detailing completed tasks, account status, and any flags across all active accounts.

Manage budgets, pacing, bid adjustments, and audience management across Meta Ads and Google Ads for 10+ active fitness clients.

Build and send weekly performance reports — pulling data, surfacing insights, and communicating clearly what's working and what isn't.

Brief the creative team on what's needed based on ad performance data, and run structured A/B tests to improve results.

Respond directly to client questions about their campaign performance with confidence and clarity.

Build monthly performance reports for all active accounts.





REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

To qualify for this role, you will need proven experience in the following:



Meta Ads 
/Instagram) — campaign setup, optimisation, audience targeting, creative testing

Google Ads — search and/or Performance Max campaigns

Performance reporting — you can pull data, interpret it, and communicate results clearly



Important: We don't care where you worked. Show us your numbers. CPLs, ROAS, spend managed, results delivered. That's what gets you hired.



SOFT SKILLS

We work in a fast-moving industry with real client budgets on the line. You'll thrive here if you are:



Data-driven and decisive — you read numbers fast and act on them

A strong communicator — clients will hear from you directly

Self-managed — you don't need to be told what to check every morning

Calm under pressure — accounts don't always behave, and we need someone who troubleshoots fast

Someone who takes ownership — you treat these accounts like they're your own





DESIRED (BONUS) SKILLS

These aren't required to get hired, but they'll give you an edge:



- Experience with fitness or gym brands

- Familiarity with AI, Adspirer or similar performance reporting tools

- Experience with HighLevel (GHL) CRM



WORK SCHEDULE

This is a full-time position (40 hours/week), Monday to Friday. Hours are flexible — we care about outcomes, not clock-watching. You'll need to be available for a weekly check-in call with our Founder.

After completing a 3-month probation period, you'll qualify for:



5 paid vacation days per year

3 paid sick days per year

We observe most Philippine public holidays





SALARY

AUD $2,500/month (approximately USD $1,600/month) for full-time work (40 hours/week)



PERKS AND BENEFITS

Once you complete your 3-month probation period, you will receive:



13th month bonus

Performance review and salary increase opportunity at the 6-month mark

Cash equivalent for unused leave days





TRAININGS PROVIDED

You'll be onboarded into Fitfam's systems, reporting tools (Adspirer), and client account structure. We'll provide full context on each client's history, targets, and creative assets so you can hit the ground running.



CAREER POTENTIAL

You'll work directly with our Founder and MD. As Fitfam grows and takes on new clients, this role has a clear path to Head of Performance — overseeing a small team of media buyers and owning the performance function of the business.



HOW TO APPLY

Put "Fitfa
dia Buyer Ready" in the subject heading — applications without this will not be considered.

In your application, include:



A brief introduction — who you are and why this role is right for you

At least 2-3 specific campaign results — tell us the platform, the objective, what you spent, and the result (CPL, ROAS, lead volume). Numbers only. No vague descriptions.

Your total years of experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads

Any tools you're currently using (Adspirer, Meta Business Suite, Google Ads Editor, etc.)



We read every application that follows these instructions. We don't read the ones that don't.



Fitfam Group Pty Ltd | Perth, WA, Australia | "Tell Epic Stories."

title: Creative Strategist - Meta Creatives (Med Spa Industry)
description:
APPLY HERE: 



We're looking for a Creative Strategist to own our medical spa clients Meta ads. The job in one sentence: keep every client's cost per lead under $12.



You do that by monitoring campaigns daily, catching rising CPLs early, and refreshing creative fast — building new ads from the ones already proven to work. We're a patient acquisition agency for medical spas and beauty clinics across the US. We run the ads, our team books the leads into appointments, and our clients get new patients.



What you'll own:



Client CPL. Every account, every day. You know where each client sits and you act before a rising CPL becomes wasted spend.



Daily account monitoring. Leads and CPL updated for every client, performance status current in ClickUp, priority accounts flagged. You work worst to best — never start with easy wins.



The creative refresh. When an account drifts above KPI, it's yours to fix: dig into the data, find what's winning and why, pause the losers, and get new creative into production fast.



Briefing the creative team. You d
 what gets made and why. Statics to our designer, videos to our editors — with clear direction, offer details, compliance notes and a deadline. Your brief should be complete enough that nobody has to ask a question.



QA and upload. Every creative checked before it goes live — pricing exact, compliance clean — then uploaded immediately.



What we're looking for:



- You understand why ads win. Hook, angle, offer, transformation image — you can look at a winning ad and explain what's actually doing the work. This is the whole job.

- You're comfortable in the numbers. CPL is your scoreboard and you act on it daily, not weekly.

- You write briefs a team can execute without asking questions. Clear direction, nothing ambiguous, always a deadline.

- You move fast. A rising CPL gets caught in days, not after two weeks of wasted spend.

title: VIDEO EDITOR (REMOTE – PHILIPPINES | PART-TIME)
description:
This Is NOT Just Another Editing Job



We are building something bigger than content. We are building a brand that dominates attention, builds trust instantly, and converts viewers into customers and clients across roofing, construction, and real estate.



If you are a high-level video editor who understands storytelling, pacing, and visual impact—and who knows how to leverage AI video tools to produce more, faster, without losing quality—keep reading.



Who We Are



We are a rapidly growing U.S.-based company operating across roofing and construction, real estate and property development, and media and community-based platforms. We move fast. We execute. And we expect excellence.



What We're Looking For



We are looking for a highly skilled, detail-oriented Video Editor (AI-Assisted) based in the Philippines who can create high-impact short-form and long-form content, generate and integrate AI-produced video, avatars, and B-roll into real client work, and turn raw footage into compelling, conversion-driven content. This is a part-time remote role, but performance-based growth opportunities are very real.



Requirements (Non-Negotiable)



First, you must be advanced in at least one major editing platform—CapCut at a high level, Adobe Premiere Pro, or Final Cut Pro. If you are not highly proficient in editing software, this role is not for you.



Second, and this is a major factor for us, you must have hands-on, proven experience generating video and visual assets with AI tools. We are talking about Veo 3 for cinematic text-to-video, Seedance for AI video generation, HeyGen for avatars and talking heads, Higgsfield for motion control and ad creative, Nano Banana for image generation and editing, and comparable platforms like Runway, Kling, Sora, ElevenLabs, or Midjourney. We actively use these tools in production every day. If you have never generated AI video and worked it into a real edit, this role is not for you. Please include AI-generated samples in your portfolio and tell us which tool produced which shot.



Your Responsibilities



On the editing side, you will cut short-form content for Reels, Shorts, and TikTok, along with long-form pieces for YouTube, brand videos, and interviews. That includes clean transitions, captions and subtitles, motion graphics, and sound design.



On the AI side, you will write effective prompts that produce usable footage rather than impressive tests. You will generate AI B-roll, product and property visuals, and scene fillers where live footage does not exist. You will build AI avatar and voiceover content for ads, explainers, and localized versions. Most importantly, you will blend AI-generated footage seamlessly with real footage so it reads as intentional, not artificial—upscaling, reframing, and cleaning up output until it is genuinely usable. Over time, you will help us track what works and build repeatable AI workflows.



You will also handle supporting design work: thumbnails, social visuals, and branding elements, all consistent with our brand style.



What Makes You a Strong Candidate



You understand storytelling, pacing, and viewer retention. You can make content feel modern, clean, and premium. You know the difference between AI footage that sells and AI footage that looks fake. You have an eye for detail and composition, you are fast and responsive and reliable, and you can follow direction while still bringing your own creative ideas. You also stay current as new tools launch, because this space changes monthly.



It is a bonus if you have edited construction, real estate, or business content before, if you understand short-form viral trends, if you know how to edit for engagement and conversions, or if you have built and documented an AI content workflow.



Work Style Expectations



This is a fast-paced environment. Clear communication is required. Deadlines matter, and quality matters more. We are not looking for average—we are looking for someone who takes pride in producing top-tier work consistently, and who sees AI as a way to do more of it.



How to Apply



Send us your portfolio or reel, at least two examples of AI-generated video you personally produced along with the tools used, and a short note on which AI tools you reach for most and why.

title: Full-Time Video Editor
description:
Hey — I’m Karos. I’m 17, and I’m running a 7-figure e-commerce brand. This is not a corporate, LinkedIn-style job post. No fluff. No buzzwords. No BS. I’m looking for a full-time Video Editor who understands direct response and actually cares about performance. This is not a “just cut clips together” role. This is about making ads that perform.



I’m building fast and I’m obsessed with results. This is only the beginning. If you join now, you’re not just editing videos — you’re growing with me, long-term. This is NOT a short-term gig. It’s a chance to build something real together.



What you’ll be doing:

Editing direct-response video ads (Meta-focused)

Creating high-converting ads, not just aesthetic edits

Producing 3 hooks per video

Turning our raw ideas + strategy into scroll-stopping creatives

Using AI tools like ElevenLabs and AI Personas where it makes sense

Iterating based on performance data

Working directly with me — fast feedback, fast decisions

Helping push the brand from “doing well” to dominating



VERY Highly valued skill:

- AI: Experience with tools like HeyGen, Google Veo, Kling, Nano Banana

Candidates with this skill set will have a strong advantage.



Who I’m looking for:

You’ve edited direct-response ads for e-commerce brands

You understand performance, not just visuals

You have a STRONG EYE for details

You’re fast, disciplined, and competitive

You care about results and high standards

You want to work exclusively on one brand and help grow it

If you want something slow, safe, and corporate — this isn’t for you.

Full-time, remote role

Base salary depends on experience and skill

Performance-based bonuses tied directly to ad results

This starts as a Video Editor role, but there’s room to grow. title: Closer (Sales, SDR, VA, Virtual Assistent, Remote Appointment Setter)
description:
If you love the fitness world, thrive on conversation, and want to be rewarded every time you turn an interested lead into a paying member, keep reading.



About Us

We are building an exclusive, high-level community for top-tier sports, health, and wellness creators. We help fitness influencers and athletes scale their impact and their business.

We are currently looking for a driven, remote Community Setter to speak with inbound leads who have already booked a call with us, qualify them, and set them up for a closer to bring them into our ecosystem.



What You'll Do

Calling Booked Leads: Working through a daily list of inbound leads who have scheduled a call after expressing interest in our community.

Following the Script: Running each call through our proven script to build rapport, uncover the lead's goals, and qualify their fit.

Qualifying: Asking the right questions to confirm the lead is a genuine match before they're passed along.

Handing Off: Booking qualified leads onto our closers' calendars, with clear notes so the closer walks in fully briefed.

Tracking: Logging every call, outcome, and follow-up to keep a clean, accurate pipeline.

Hitting Targets: Meeting clear daily and weekly targets for calls made, leads qualified, and calls booked with closers.



Note: You are not closing the sale yourself and you are not managing creators once they join. Your singular focus is qualifying inbound leads and setting them up for the close.



What We Provide

A Ready-Made Script: A proven call script and objection-handling framework — you won't be improvising from scratch.

Warm Leads: Every lead you call has already booked the call themselves — no cold outreach.

Coaching: Regular call reviews and feedback to sharpen your delivery and your numbers.

Growth: A clear progression path into closing or senior team roles for top performers.



Pay and Progression

A fixed monthly base amount, plus

Commission on every sale closed from a call you qualified and set.

Motivated setters who consistently deliver well-qualified calls can build a strong, growing income stream. Exact details of the compensation structure and progression path will be explained during the interview process.



Who You Are (You're a fit if...)

Reliable & Honest: You show up, do the work, and communicate transparently.

Highly Motivated: You're a self-starter who loves the thrill of a good conversation and hitting targets.

Culturally Plugged In: You naturally consume fitness content and understand the world these creators live in.

Coachable, Not Robotic: You can run a script consistently while still sounding human and adapting to the person on the other end of the line.

Equipped: You have reliable internet, a working computer, and a quiet place to work.



Requirements

Strong written and spoken English.

Comfortable running back-to-back calls off a set schedule.

Consistent daily availability for scheduled calls and follow-ups.



How to Apply

Apply here: 
/t/6ni393yCWvus



This is a short form where we ask about your experience, your familiarity with the fitness space, and your expectations. If it looks like a potential fit on paper, we will reach out with the next steps for an interview!

title: Remote Appointment Setter (Sales, SDR, VA, Virtual Assistent)
description:
If you love the fitness world, thrive on conversation, and want to be rewarded every time you turn an interested lead into a paying member, keep reading.



About Us

We are building an exclusive, high-level community for top-tier sports, health, and wellness creators. We help fitness influencers and athletes scale their impact and their business.

We are currently looking for a driven, remote Community Setter to speak with inbound leads who have already booked a call with us, qualify them, and set them up for a closer to bring them into our ecosystem.



What You'll Do

Calling Booked Leads: Working through a daily list of inbound leads who have scheduled a call after expressing interest in our community.

Following the Script: Running each call through our proven script to build rapport, uncover the lead's goals, and qualify their fit.

Qualifying: Asking the right questions to confirm the lead is a genuine match before they're passed along.

Handing Off: Booking qualified leads onto our closers' calendars, with clear notes so the closer walks in fully briefed.

Tracking: Logging every call, outcome, and follow-up to keep a clean, accurate pipeline.

Hitting Targets: Meeting clear daily and weekly targets for calls made, leads qualified, and calls booked with closers.



Note: You are not closing the sale yourself and you are not managing creators once they join. Your singular focus is qualifying inbound leads and setting them up for the close.



What We Provide

A Ready-Made Script: A proven call script and objection-handling framework — you won't be improvising from scratch.

Warm Leads: Every lead you call has already booked the call themselves — no cold outreach.

Coaching: Regular call reviews and feedback to sharpen your delivery and your numbers.

Growth: A clear progression path into closing or senior team roles for top performers.



Pay and Progression

A fixed monthly base amount, plus

Commission on every sale closed from a call you qualified and set.

Motivated setters who consistently deliver well-qualified calls can build a strong, growing income stream. Exact details of the compensation structure and progression path will be explained during the interview process.



Who You Are (You're a fit if...)

Reliable & Honest: You show up, do the work, and communicate transparently.

Highly Motivated: You're a self-starter who loves the thrill of a good conversation and hitting targets.

Culturally Plugged In: You naturally consume fitness content and understand the world these creators live in.

Coachable, Not Robotic: You can run a script consistently while still sounding human and adapting to the person on the other end of the line.

Equipped: You have reliable internet, a working computer, and a quiet place to work.



Requirements

Strong written and spoken English.

Comfortable running back-to-back calls off a set schedule.

Consistent daily availability for scheduled calls and follow-ups.



How to Apply

Apply here:

title: Intelligence Analyst / Investigator
description:
Job Duties:



Conduct comprehensive background investigations using investigative databases, public records, and OSINT resources.

Perform social media investigations across platforms including
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X/Twitter, and others.

Identify and document relevant activity, employment indicators, travel, lifestyle inconsistencies, and actionable intelligence.

Analyze digital footprints, associates, family connections, business affiliations, vehicles, and online activity patterns.

Assist with pre-surveillance intelligence development and field investigation support.

Prepare detailed investigative reports, timelines, summaries, and supporting documentation.

Conduct skip tracing and locate investigations.

Utilize mapping tools, property records, corporate filings, criminal records, and other public sources to develop investigative leads.

Review claimant statements, claim documentation, medical records, and supporting evidence when applicable.

Maintain accurate case documentation while ensuring compliance with legal, ethical, and confidentiality standards.

Collaborate with management, operations, and field investigators to support investigative strategy development.

 



Skills Needed:



Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.

Excellent written communication and report writing skills.

Strong online research and investigative abilities.

Familiarity with social media platforms and investigative methodologies.

Ability to identify inconsistencies, red flags, and investigative opportunities.

Strong organizational and time management skills.

Ability to work independently and manage multiple assignments simultaneously.

Comfortable utilizing technology, investigative software, databases, and AI-assisted research tools.

Professional demeanor with the ability to maintain strict confidentiality.

Critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

 



Educational/Experience Qualifications:



High school diploma or equivalent required.

Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Intelligence Studies, Journalism, Cybersecurity, Communications, or related field preferred.

Prior investigative experience preferred but not required.

Experience in insurance investigations, SIU, surveillance, background investigations, law enforcement, military intelligence, legal investigations, journalism, cybersecurity, fraud analysis, or related fields is highly desirable.

Familiarity with OSINT methodologies and investigative research techniques preferred.

 



Qualifications & Equipment:



Reliable computer with high-speed internet connection.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and online investigative tools.

Ability to work remotely and independently.

Strong typing and documentation skills.

Experience using the following software systems is desired: Trackops, Clear, TLO, IRB, Page Vault, Hunchly, Brave Browser, MS 365.

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
DeepSky is committed to results-oriented individuals who are ready to contribute to our mission of providing financial literacy to entrepreneurs in the US. We are currently hiring a Marketing Assistant to execute our speaking-driven marketing engine. If you're someone who can run outreach consistently, turn a keynote into a week of content, and follow a brand guideline exactly, consider joining our team.



You will work directly with our Marketing Lead. Your job is execution: lists, outreach, sequences, social content, presentations, and funnels. Every talk our founder gives becomes content you produce and distribute. Every speaking opportunity you help book feeds the engine.



This is not an admin role. There is no inbox management, no scheduling, no back-office work. 100% of your time goes to marketing execution.



Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:



Outreach & Booking:

Building and maintaining outreach lists

Running daily LinkedIn outreach and speaking-opportunity outreach

Coordinating speech bookings and follow-ups

Managing
 sequences

Content & Social:

Repurposing keynote talks and webinars into LinkedIn,
, and Instagram content

Managing and growing our social media accounts

Producing content that follows our brand guideline exactly

Presentations & Funnels:

Preparing presentations following our brand guideline

Building and maintaining funnels: landing pages, forms, follow-up sequences

Learning:

Attending a structured marketing coaching program alongside our Marketing Lead

Completing the program's weekly assignments on time



+About You:

You have real, hands-on experience running social media accounts for a business, not just your personal profile. You have built or run at least one real funnel or ad campaign and can show the numbers. You communicate clearly in written and spoken English. You have design sense, or at minimum the discipline to follow a brand guideline without improvising. You use AI tools in your daily work, or are genuinely eager to. You deliver consistently without being chased.



Bonus, not required: you can understand spoken Mandarin. Speaking is not required.



+Additional Requirement:

Please include your resume, answers to the two short questions below, links to one social media account you have managed and one funnel, campaign, or design sample you produced, and your expected monthly salary. We care about what you have actually done, not how polished your writing is. Short, specific answers with real numbers are better than long generic ones.



You're welcome to use AI as a tool. Much of this role is content production, so if you can use AI to produce clear, on-brand work, that's the same quality our audience will receive. We see that as a skill, not a shortcut.



However, the final interview will test your real-time English ability directly. We will also follow up on your answers during the interview.



Tell me about a social media account you managed for a business. Which platform, what was your role, what did you post, and what actually grew: followers, reach, or leads? Please use real numbers. (3 to 5 sentences is enough.)

Tell me about one funnel or ad campaign you personally executed. What was the goal, what did you build, and what were the results? Please use a real example with numbers. (3 to 5 sentences is enough.)



Applications that do not include answers to both questions will automatically be excluded from consideration.



During the initial 3-month trial period, candidates will undergo educational and training sessions. Afterward, successful candidates will be offered full-time positions with comprehensive company benefits. In addition to base salary, this role earns a performance bonus for every new client closed through the marketing engine.



This position requires working 9am to 6pm US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday, to work alongside our US-based team and audience. For candidates based in the Philippines, this translates to 9pm to 6am Manila time, Monday evening through Saturday morning. Please only apply if you are able and willing to work this schedule consistently long-term.



+Success Metrics during the trial period:

All coaching-program assignments completed on time

Daily outreach batches sent on schedule, every working day

Every talk or webinar repurposed into published content within 5 working days

All output follows the brand guideline with no exceptions

We’re a fast-growing online marketing powerhouse, running products loved by customers in more than 15 countries.

VSL ads (primary) — long-form

 for

Software

Adobe Premiere Pro — required, must be proficient

Hours & compensation

Part-time to start — we're an early-stage brand, and hours will grow as we scale ad spend

1 month paid trial period

Long-term position for the right person

Paid screening test edit for shortlisted candidates

Clear, timestamped feedback

Software you use daily and your level in each

Your availability (hours per day, timezone)



No portfolio = no review.

title: Operations and Accountability Lead
description:
If keeping people moving toward a goal is just "how you're wired", and watching 
ntum die HURTS you to your core - read on.



You're the person who can't leave a loop open.



When something was supposed to happen and didn't, you FEEL it.



Not because you need control - because incomplete action is genuinely uncomfortable to you.



You follow through - not because someone asked you to, but because it comes naturally to you.



You don't need to be the loudest person in the room. You don't need credit. You need COMPLETION.



The Work



Your job, put simply, is this -

Make sure the right things are happening at the right time.



Right now that means one defined project with a clear finish line. 



We're building a system from zero - setting it up, getting it running, and making sure it's documented and tested before it goes live. 



That's Phase One. 



Your job is to make sure it crosses the finish line completely and correctly.



After that, the work shifts to three ongoing modes:



First, you'll own the recurring pulse - ensuring pipeline, commitments, and follow-through are done on time and completely. Making sure nothing goes cold without a deliberate decision to let it go cold.



Then you'll help prioritize and delegate what comes up - the one-off tasks, the gaps that need closing along the way.



And you'll keep the system honest - making sure the people responsible for keeping it moving are actually keeping it moving.



You're not DOING the work. 



You're MAKING SURE the work GETS DONE.



You won't be on an island.



The answers, the context, the access - it's all there when you need it.



You only have to ask for it, use it to help build the systems we need, and make sure everyone is doing their part to keep that system moving.



The Offer



This is a small team with a proven offering.



It's made up of people that genuinely want to be held accountable.



That's not something you'll find everywhere.



You'll have real access, real permission, and a team that's actively asking for what you naturally do.



If you're the person we're describing, this isn't just "a job". It's the right fit for you.



Details



This starts as a defined project. If you execute it well, it becomes an ongoing role.



This is a full time position starting at $4/hour.



Some familiarity with CRM systems or marketing automation is helpful. If you have the character and a general familiarity with the skills, we'll train you on everything else.



Tools, systems, process - all of that can be learned.



What can't be taught is HOW YOU'RE WIRED.



When the core project is complete, we'll find work that fits you. You won't be left idle.



To Apply



When you apply, tell us about a time something was ABOUT TO fall through the cracks and YOU were the reason it didn't.



In Closing



If you need to be managed, this isn't the right fit.



If you're the one who usually ends up doing the managing - even when it's not your job - and you'd love a role where that's exactly what's needed - let's talk.



'Cuz honestly, WE need to be managed.

title: Supply Chain & Logistics Lead: Inventory Planning & Demand Forecasting (Amazon FBA)
description:
We run two complementary e-commerce Amazon FBA brands: one in a premium giftable category with strong Christmas seasonality, one in sports & fitness. We are at ~200 SKUs today, with a clear roadmap to ~500. We sell across Amazon US, UK &.Canada, manufacture in China, and ship into FBA, AWD, and 3PLs across the US, UK, and Canada.



** THE ROLE **



This is a senior role. The CEO and Head of Operations are looking for a trusted operator to take ownership of the supply chain and logistics function, “end-to-end”, from initial forecasting -to- factory floor -to- FBA shelf. Someone we can hand the keys to and trust to drive it forward with little oversight.



You'll inherit a well-documented operation, with a structured onboarding: our current Supply Chain Manager will support your transition, transferring knowledge of both brands, our suppliers, and our systems so you can take the reins with confidence.



We also expect you to work AI-first. The best person for this role uses AI daily: to pressure-test forecasts, draft communications, build formulas, and automate the repetitive parts of logistics coordination. At the same time, you verify every output before it touches a decision. AI leverage is how one sharp operator runs what used to take a full department.



** WHAT YOU WILL OWN **



— Supply chain strategy and execution across both brands, “end-to-end”. Each runs its own forecasting methodology; you'll master both and standardize where it genuinely helps

— Demand forecasting and order planning for 200 SKUs (scaling to 500), built in Google Sheets with the backing of solid data flows

— China manufacturer relationships and procurement: purchase orders (POs): production scheduling, inspections, quality, MOQ and pricing negotiation, alternate sourcing

— International freight and logistics coordination: coordinator of carrier selection, cost vs. transit time, customs compliance, freight forwarders, 3PLs

— FBA inventory health: replenishment timing, 45 to 90 days cover, avoiding stockouts and overstock, inbound receiving discrepancies, reimbursements, cases with Amazon

— The small, critical details: barcodes, FNSKUs, shipment labeling, compliance documentation, tracking reconciliation. You are the last line of defense

— A performance dashboard you build and own: forecast accuracy, inventory turnover, lead time, on-time-in-full, stockout rate, shipping cost per unit, cash-flow planning

— Alignment with marketing and sales (a lightweight S&OP rhythm), so inventory matches promotional plans and seasonality. Flagged early, with numbers

— Task and process management in ClickUp: every shipment, order, supplier action, and follow-up lives in ClickUp so the whole team has visibility, and nothing falls through the cracks. You will be expected to maintain it rigorously, not treat it as optional

— Proactive communication: updates prior to asking, risks flagged early, follow-through without being chased



** WHAT OWNERSHIP MEANS HERE **



In supply chain management, small mistakes compound: one wrong barcode or missed reorder point can be costly. So we work to a clear standard. Sanity checking is built into how you operate: reconciling totals, second-passing formulas, and gut-checking outputs against reality before they drive a decision. Occasional errors are part of the job; what we can't carry is the same error recurring, going unnoticed, or going unexplained. When something does go wrong, you own it: what happened, why, the impact, and the fix that stops it repeating. Work like that, and you'll have our full backing when things go sideways.



** MUST HAVES: SKILLS & EXPERIENCE **



— 4+ years in supply chain or inventory management, with 2+ years personally running an Amazon FBA supply chain “end-to-end” (Bachelor's in Supply Chain or related field is a plus)

— Proven experience managing 100+ SKUs; multi-brand portfolios a plus

— Deep international logistics knowledge: sea freight, customs, import/export compliance

— Strong Seller Central command: restock/capacity limits, IPI, shipment creation, FNSKU and barcode management, AWD vs. FBA

— Hands-on purchasing experience with overseas manufacturers: raising POs, tracking production, reconciling deliveries

— Advanced Google Sheets/Excel. You build models, not just populate them (array formulas, pivot tables, QUERY, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, IMPORTRANGE). We will ask to see analyses you've built.

— Demonstrable AI fluency: real examples of AI saving you hours, and of catching it when it was wrong or hallucinating

— Experience with seasonal products and Christmas demand spikes

— Comfortable delegating and reviewing the work of others when needed

— Fluent English, written and verbal (Mandarin/Chinese a bonus for supplier communications in their native language)



** WORK SETUP **



Reliable electricity and 50+ Mbps internet, your own computer, and a quiet workspace. We run all tasks, processes, and reporting through ClickUp: it is our central hub for visibility across the team, and strong comfort with it is a requirement, not a nice-to-have. Working hours must overlap with China and UK hours (e.g., roughly 2pm to 10pm PH time, or a split shift like PHT 10am to 2pm & 6pm to 10pm). We're flexible on the shape, as long as the crossover is there.



** PERSONALITY WE'RE LOOKING FOR **



A logician's mind: structured, methodical, rigorous. Obsessively detail-oriented, so spotting an off barcode or an ambiguously worded supplier quote is your default mode, not an effort. The right fit is someone with real agency: you push for action, take ownership without waiting to be asked, and juggle parallel priorities without losing oversight of the details. An independent operator and self-starter who stays calm under pressure during peak-season spikes and shipping delays. Fully accountable. Always improving the system.



** NOT A FIT IF YOU **



— Need step-by-step instructions

— Are a generalist VA with peripheral supply chain exposure

— Have not personally managed an FBA supply chain “end-to-end”

— Find details tedious, or paste AI output without checking it

— Are juggling multiple other clients



** THE PACKAGE **



— Full-time, 40 hrs/week; bi-weekly salary (3rd and 18th of the month)

— $1,900 to $2,400+/month base (PHP 120,000 to 150,000+), equivalent to $11 to $14+ per hour, depending on experience

— 13th-month pay, pro-rated each December

— Health reimbursement up to $50/month (HMO, PhilHealth, Maxicare, etc.)



** HOW TO APPLY **



Complete the application form below. It includes a few short questions and two brief video uploads (you can submit partially and return to finish later):



Apply via this link:

title: Remote Appointment Setter (SDR, Sales, VA, Virtual Assistent)
description:
If you love the fitness world, thrive on conversation, and want to be rewarded every time you turn an interested lead into a paying member, keep reading.



About Us

We are building an exclusive, high-level community for top-tier sports, health, and wellness creators. We help fitness influencers and athletes scale their impact and their business.

We are currently looking for a driven, remote Community Setter to speak with inbound leads who have already booked a call with us, qualify them, and set them up for a closer to bring them into our ecosystem.



What You'll Do

Calling Booked Leads: Working through a daily list of inbound leads who have scheduled a call after expressing interest in our community.

Following the Script: Running each call through our proven script to build rapport, uncover the lead's goals, and qualify their fit.

Qualifying: Asking the right questions to confirm the lead is a genuine match before they're passed along.

Handing Off: Booking qualified leads onto our closers' calendars, with clear notes so the closer walks in fully briefed.

Tracking: Logging every call, outcome, and follow-up to keep a clean, accurate pipeline.

Hitting Targets: Meeting clear daily and weekly targets for calls made, leads qualified, and calls booked with closers.



Note: You are not closing the sale yourself and you are not managing creators once they join. Your singular focus is qualifying inbound leads and setting them up for the close.



What We Provide

A Ready-Made Script: A proven call script and objection-handling framework — you won't be improvising from scratch.

Warm Leads: Every lead you call has already booked the call themselves — no cold outreach.

Coaching: Regular call reviews and feedback to sharpen your delivery and your numbers.

Growth: A clear progression path into closing or senior team roles for top performers.



Pay and Progression

A fixed monthly base amount, plus

Commission on every sale closed from a call you qualified and set.

Motivated setters who consistently deliver well-qualified calls can build a strong, growing income stream. Exact details of the compensation structure and progression path will be explained during the interview process.



Who You Are (You're a fit if...)

Reliable & Honest: You show up, do the work, and communicate transparently.

Highly Motivated: You're a self-starter who loves the thrill of a good conversation and hitting targets.

Culturally Plugged In: You naturally consume fitness content and understand the world these creators live in.

Coachable, Not Robotic: You can run a script consistently while still sounding human and adapting to the person on the other end of the line.

Equipped: You have reliable internet, a working computer, and a quiet place to work.



Requirements

Strong written and spoken English.

Comfortable running back-to-back calls off a set schedule.

Consistent daily availability for scheduled calls and follow-ups.



How to Apply

Apply here: 



This is a short form where we ask about your experience, your familiarity with the fitness space, and your expectations. If it looks like a potential fit on paper, we will reach out with the next steps for an interview!

title: Senior Finance & ERP Operations Specialist
description:
Company: Suits Finance

Work Arrangement: Remote (Full-time)

Compensation: Market-conform salary

Availability: Immediate





About Suits Finance



Suits Finance is a dynamic financial services firm providing data-driven and cross-border solutions for global entrepreneurs, corporate entities, and e-commerce businesses. We specialize in accounting, tax compliance, corporate structuring, banking, and regulatory coordination across multiple jurisdictions.



As our company continues to grow, we are looking for a Senior Finance & ERP Operations Specialist to strengthen our back office operations. This is a senior-level position for an experienced finance professional who enjoys working with financial processes, ERP systems, and operational excellence.



You will work closely with one of our senior back office tea
mbers and play a key role in ensuring that our finance operations run efficiently and accurately.





Position Overview



As our Senior Finance & ERP Operations Specialist, you will be responsible for overseeing critical day-to-day finance and operational processes. This includes managing sales orders, invoices, accounts receivable, purchase orders, project costing, timesheet allocations, and daily bank postings.



This role is ideal for someone who has previously worked as a Finance Manager, Financial Controller, Management Controller, Senior Accountant, or in a similar senior finance position. While experience with Odoo is preferred, we understand that experienced Odoo professionals are difficult to find. Candidates with strong experience using other ERP systems are highly encouraged to apply.



Beyond executing daily operations, we are looking for someone who can identify process improvements, maintain financial accuracy, and contribute to building efficient internal workflows.





Key Responsibilities



Finance Operations

- Review and approve sales orders.

- Manage outgoing invoices and monitor accounts receivable.

- Follow up on outstanding invoices and ensure timely collections.

- Process incoming supplier invoices and allocate costs to the correct client or internal projects.

- Review and post daily bank transactions while maintaining accurate financial records.



ERP & Project Management

- Manage project costing and ensure expenses are allocated correctly.

- Assign employee timesheets to the appropriate projects and internal budgets where manual allocation is required.

- Review automated project allocations and ensure their accuracy.

- Implement and manage purchase orders.

- Match incoming supplier invoices against approved purchase orders and investigate discrepancies.



Back Office Operations

- Work closely with the finance and operations team to maintain efficient internal processes.

- Ensure financial records remain complete, accurate, and up to date.

- Support month-end operational activities and reporting.

- Identify opportunities to improve workflows and internal controls.

- Collaborate with different departments to resolve operational and financial matters.



Qualifications & Requirements

- Proven experience in a senior finance, accounting, or back office operations role.

- Previous experience as a Finance Manager, Financial Controller, Management Controller, Senior Accountant, or similar is highly preferred.

- Strong understanding of:

          - Accounts Receivable

          - Accounts Payable

          - Purchase Orders

          - Bank Reconciliations

          - Project Costing

          - Financial Operations

- Experience working with ERP systems is required.

- Experience with Odoo is preferred but not required. We value strong ERP experience, whether it comes from SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Business Central, Sage, Odoo, or similar platforms.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.

- Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with an international team.

- Self-motivated, proactive, and continuously looking for ways to improve processes.





Why Join Suits Finance?



- Join a rapidly growing international financial services company.

- Work with entrepreneurs and businesses from around the world.

- Enjoy a fully remote work environment with supportive leadership.

- Take ownership of meaningful finance and operational responsibilities.

- Be part of a team that values efficiency, innovation, and continuous improvement.

- Gain hands-on experience with international finance operations and ERP-driven workflows.

- Have opportunities to grow professionally as the company continues to expand.





Application Process



If you believe you're the right fit for this role, we'd love to hear from you.



Please submit your resume along with a brief cover letter highlighting:

- Your experience in senior finance or accounting roles.

- The ERP systems you have worked with.

- Your experience managing finance and operational processes.

- Why you believe you would be a great addition to Suits Finance.



We strictly do not accept applications via
. Please submit your application only through this platform.

description:
FIRST LINE: How many years of experience do you have as a Property Manager?

SECOND LINE: List down the softwares that you have used



I own a fast-growing, high-volume residential property management business based in Australia. Our team manages a portfolio of 1,000+ properties, and we are scaling quickly!



To keep up with our growth, I am looking for an experienced, proactive Property Management Virtual Assistant to take ownership of our day-to-day administrative backend. You won’t just be doing "light admin"—you’ll be the backbone of our operations, keeping our systems spotless and ensuring our onshore team can focus on client relationships and expansion.



What You’ll Be Doing

In this role, you will handle full-cycle property management administration inside our systems:



Maintenance & Repairs: Log, triage, and coordinate maintenance end-to-end. Get quote approvals from owners, book tradespeople, issue entry notices, and follow up until the job is done.



Compliance: Track and maintain current compliance records (smoke alarms, gas/electrical safety, pool compliance, water efficiency) and audit files for missing certificates.



Leasing & Tenancy Admin: Process lease renewals, prepare documentation, manage inspection reports (entry, routine, exit), and keep property records updated.



Inbox & Communications: Manage administrative and maintenance inboxes—providing fast, professional updates to owners, tenants, and tradespeople.



System Accuracy: Keep our database accurate, upload invoices, update profiles, and run regular operational reports.



What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves (Non-Negotiable):

Software: Hands-on, practical experience using Property Me AND/OR Property Tree

Portfolio Experience: Proven track record supporting a large residential rent roll (high volume, several hundred+ properties).

Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of Australian property management workflows (maintenance, compliance, leasing, and inspections).

Communication: Exceptional written and spoken English with a professional, clear communication style.

Attributes: Proactive, highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to work independently at high volume.



Nice-to-Haves:

Experience with state-based compliance laws and issuing entry notices.

Exposure to trust accounting or invoicing.

Experience working across multiple offices or business entities.

title: VIDEO/IMAGE EDITOR
description:
About Us

We’re a fast-growing e-commerce company running multiple dropshipping brands across Poland and other European markets. We sell digital products targeted at men and women aged 35+.

New products and brands can launch at any time — so there’s always something new to work on and improve.



The Role

We’re looking for a full-time Video/image Editor who specializes in creating scroll-stopping, authentic UGC-style video ads for Meta.

You’ll work closely with our team — we provide scripts, creative concepts, and access to our content library. Your job is to turn these ideas into high-converting ads that feel real, natural, and engaging.



What You’ll Be Creating

AI UGC ads (30–60 seconds) – testimonial style, “someone recommending a product they genuinely love”





Mini VSLs (1–2 minutes)



Images





Iterations of winning creatives





Multiple hooks per concept (we typically test 3 hooks + 1 shared body per concept)

Your Responsibilities

Edit 2–3 high-quality ad concepts per day (quality over quantity — we prefer 4 strong ads over 6 average ones)





Source additional footage online when needed to match the script





Add captions/subtitles to all videos





Select fitting background music





Generate AI voiceovers using ElevenLabs





Create AI UGC avatars using HeyGen and Veo

Requirements

Experience editing UGC-style ads for e-commerce (even a few months is fine if your work is strong)





Proficiency with AI tools: HeyGen, Veo, ElevenLabs (required)





Strong understanding of what makes content feel authentic and scroll-stopping





Ability to source visuals and create cohesive ads where footage matches the script





Communicative to advanced English





Reliable, self-motivated, and able to work independently







Nice to Have

Experience working with Polish-language ads (not required, but a plus)







What We Offer

$900–1,000 USD/month (depending on experience)





Full-time position (8 hours/day, flexible schedule — no need to overlap with European time zone)





Access to all necessary subscriptions: HeyGen, Veo, ElevenLabs, and any new tools that help us create better ads





Long-term collaboration — grow with us as we scale





Clear path toward becoming a Creative Strategist as we expand the team





Opportunity to deepen your AI-driven content creation skills







How to Apply

Reach out to us and we’ll send you a test task:

You’ll receive an ad concept with a script and create 2 short videos — 2 different hooks with 1 shared body.

This will allow us to evaluate your editing skills, creativity, and style.

title: Shopify, Printify, Etsy and Social Media Expert
description:
Shopify, Etsy and Printify Expert — Shore Vibes by Maria and Shore Summer Rentals (25 hrs/week)



Shore Vibes by Maria is a new coastal beach apparel and lifestyle brand based in New Jersey, alongside our sister vacation rental company Shore Summer Rentals. We’re looking for an experienced VA to take over product uploads, store management, and SEO optimization — then stay on long-term as we grow.



This position is not for someone who is looking to be trained, I am looking for someone who takes charge and gets the job done with little hand holding. Pay is based on experience.



What you’ll do:



• Add and edit products (titles, descriptions, images, variants, pricing)

• Make theme edits using CSS — section layouts, styling tweaks, seasonal updates

• Update homepage banners, collections, and promotions

• Create and manage our Etsy shop, including listings and shop settings

• Manage our Printify account — product setup, mockups, order syncing

• Optimize SEO across Shopify and Etsy: keyword research, tags, meta titles, meta descriptions

• Create ads for social media

• Help manage Shore Summer Rentals
 pages, including replying to guests asking about vacation rentals and owners interested in advertising with us



Who we need:



Attention to detail matters more than speed. If you’re someone who double-checks your own work before turning it in, this is for you. If you tend to move fast and figure it out later, this isn’t a fit.



Requirements:



• Advanced, hands-on Shopify experience, including CSS theme customization

• Proven experience creating and managing Etsy shops

• Proven experience managing Printify accounts (product setup, order fulfillment)

• Strong working knowledge of SEO — keyword research, tags, meta titles, meta descriptions

• A portfolio of real Shopify and Etsy Etsy stores you’ve built or managed (links required)

• At least 2 professional references from past clients

• Excellent written English — you’ll be corresponding directly with our rental clients and hosts

• Comfortable working independently with minimal oversight

• Willingness to complete a short skills/English test before final hiring decision



Nice to have: Meta Pixel, Canva or Kittl, prior experience in customer service or hospitality



To apply, please include, in this order:



1. Start your message with the word “vibes” — this just tells us you read the full post

2. A short note on your Shopify, Etsy, and Printify experience

3. Links to 2–3 stores you’ve worked on

4. Two references (name, relationship, contact info)

5. Your hourly rate and hours available per week



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a brief written test as part of the interview process.



Applications missing the portfolio, references, or the word above won’t be reviewed.



We’re a small brand and this only works if we can trust the work without re-checking it. If that’s how you operate, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Website & SEO Specialist
description:
About Us

TYS, S.L.U. is an international company based in the Principality of Andorra. For many years, we have provided crew placement services for the superyacht industry.



As part of our continued growth, we have expanded into software development. We currently have one software product in the market, another awaiting its official release, and a third scheduled for launch at the end of Q1 2027.



We are looking for a Website & SEO Specialist who can take ownership of our websites, improve our online presence, and support the continued growth of our software portfolio.



Job Summary

You will be responsible for managing and optimizing our websites while implementing SEO strategies that increase visibility, drive organic traffic, improve conversions, and support our marketing initiatives through engaging visual and multimedia content.



Working closely with management and the Growth team, you will ensure our websites are fast, user-friendly, search engine optimized, and aligned with our business objectives. We are looking for someone who can work independently, identify opportunities for improvement, and take ownership of website performance with minimal supervision.



Key Responsibilities

* Manage, maintain, and update our WordPress websites.

* Plan and implement on-page and technical SEO strategies.

* Conduct keyword research and optimize website content for search engines.

* Create, update, and optimize landing pages.

* Improve website speed, usability, and overall user experience.

* Set up and maintain Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and other tracking tools.

* Monitor website analytics and prepare performance reports.

* Identify opportunities to improve organic search rankings and conversion rates.

* Create and update website graphics, banners, and other visual assets.

* Edit promotional videos and marketing content for websites, social media, and product launches.

* Collaborate with the Growth team to produce creative assets that support marketing campaigns.

* Perform routine website maintenance, testing, and quality assurance.

* Coordinate with developers when technical implementation is required.

* Ensure websites remain secure, updated, and properly maintained.

* Stay up to date with SEO trends, search engine algorithm updates, and industry best practices.



Requirements

* Proven experience managing WordPress websites.

* Strong proficiency with Elementor or a similar WordPress page builder.

* Practical experience with SEO, including keyword research, on-page optimization, and technical SEO.

* Proficiency in video editing using DaVinci Resolve.

* Experience using Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.

* Understanding of Core Web Vitals and website performance optimization.

* Basic HTML and CSS knowledge.

* Experience with conversion rate optimization (CRO).

* Proficiency in graphic design using  Canva, or similar.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

* Is willing to commit exclusively to this full-time position.



Working Hours

* Monday to Friday

* 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Andorra time)

* One-hour unpaid lunch break from 12:00 PM to 1:00 PM (Andorra time)



Compensation & Benefits

* Starting salary: PHP 30,000 per month

* Philippine holidays observed

* 20 days annual leave

* 15 days paid sick leave

* In-house healthcare fund after successful completion of probation

* Opportunity to grow with an international software company



How to Apply

Please send your CV along with a short cover letter explaining your relevant experience and why you would be a good fit for this role.

title: Facebook & Taboola Ads Assistant + Product Researcher
description:
#
 Ads & Taboola Ads Assistant + Product Researcher



We are looking for an experienced *
 Ads and 
 Ads Assistant** to join our e-commerce team for long-term cooperation.



This is **not a Media Buyer position**. You will not be responsible for campaign optimization, budget management, performance analysis, or scaling campaigns.



Your main responsibilities will be:



1. Launching and uploading advertisements using ready-made materials provided by our team.

2. Conducting daily product research and finding new products for us to test.



We are looking for someone who already has practical experience with advertising platforms. **We do not want to teach someone how to create campaigns, ad sets, or ads from scratch.**



## Advertising Tasks



You will work mainly with *
 Ads Manager and 
 Ads**.



All advertising materials will be prepared and provided by our team, including videos, images, ad copy, headlines, and landing page links.



Your job will simply be to correctly upload and launch them according to our instructions.



Typical tasks will include:



* Adding a new ad set to an existing campaign

* Adding new ads and creatives to existing ad sets

* Creating new campaigns using our predefined structure

* Launching a new campaign with 3 initial ad sets

* Adding additional ad sets and creatives in the following days as new materials are prepared by our video editor

* Checking that all ads, links, tracking settings, and campaign structures are set up correctly



Our campaign setup is standardized. New campaigns are launched using the same predefined starting budgets and structures, so you will not need to make decisions about budgets or campaign strategy.



**Campaign optimization is handled by another person on our team.**



You will NOT be responsible for:



* Optimizing campaigns

* Scaling or reducing budgets

* Analyzing campaign performance

* D
 which ads should be turned off

* Developing advertising strategies



However, you must already understand how
 Ads Manager works and be able to independently create campaigns, ad sets, and ads.



Experience with Taboola Ads is a strong advantage. If you already understand the basics of native advertising platforms, the work will be straightforward.



## Daily Product Research



The second part of your role will be conducting daily product research.



We will provide you with access to the research tool we use and explain our criteria for selecting products.



Your responsibility will be to:



* Research new e-commerce products every day

* Analyze products currently being advertised and sold online

* Identify products that match our criteria

* Find **3 promising products per day**

* Add all selected products to our shared Excel/Google Sheets file

* Include the required links and information for each product



You do not need to make the final decision about which products we launch. Your responsibility is to consistently find and organize potential products for our team to review.



## Requirements



You should:



* Have practical experience with
 Ads Manager

* Know how to create campaigns, ad sets, and ads without training

* Understand the basic structure of
 advertising campaigns

* Be able to follow predefined campaign structures and instructions

* Have experience uploading and launching ads using ready-made creatives

* Be comfortable working with spreadsheets such as Excel or Google Sheets

* Be able to conduct online product research

* Be organized and pay strong attention to detail

* Be able to work independently and complete daily tasks consistently



Experience with **Taboola Ads** and e-commerce product research is a strong advantage.



**We are not looking for a complete beginner.** You should already know how to work inside
 Ads Manager. We can explain our internal processes and campaign structures, but we do not want to teach the basics of launching advertisements.



## About the Work



We operate multiple e-commerce stores and regularly launch and test new products across different markets.



Your daily work will be structured and repetitive. You will receive ready-made advertising materials from our team, upload them according to our predefined system, and conduct daily product research.



The strategic side of advertising, campaign optimization, budget management, and scaling is handled by other members of our team.



We are looking for someone reliable, accurate, and consistent who wants to work with us **long-term**.



## How to Apply



Please send us:



* A short description of your experience with
 Ads Manager

* Your experience with Taboola Ads, if any

* Your experience with e-commerce or product research

* How long you have been working with advertising platforms

* Your availability

* Your expected monthly salary



Please start your application with the word **"ADS"** so we know you have read the full job description.

title: Shopify expert
description:
# Shopify Store Builder / Landing Page Specialist



We are looking for an experienced **Shopify Specialist** to join our e-commerce team for long-term cooperation.



This is a hands-on role for someone who already knows Shopify very well and can work independently. **We are not looking for a beginner.** You should be comfortable working inside Shopify without needing explanations of basic features or processes.



## Your Main Responsibilities



Your daily tasks will include:



* Building and editing Shopify product pages

* Creating advertorial pages and landing pages

* Adding and launching new products

* Setting up and managing Shopify Markets

* Creating localized versions of stores and products for different countries

* Copying and recreating page structures from reference websites

* Building pages inspired by existing competitors and successful stores

* Making adjustments to existing product pages and advertorials

* Handling general Shopify-related tasks required to launch and test new products



Most daily tasks will be connected to either:



**1. Launching a new product** — creating the product page, advertorial, and everything needed to prepare it for advertising.



**2. Working on an existing product** — for example, adding a new advertorial, creating a new landing page, or preparing the product for another market.



We will usually provide you with reference websites, competitor pages, or examples of what we want. Your job is to recreate the structure, adapt it to our brand and product, and make sure everything works correctly.



## Requirements



You should:



* Have strong practical experience with Shopify

* Be able to work independently inside Shopify

* Know how to build and customize product pages and landing pages

* Understand Shopify Markets and multi-country store setups

* Be comfortable working with Shopify themes and Custom Liquid

* Be able to recreate designs and page structures based on reference websites

* Have good attention to detail

* Work efficiently and follow daily tasks and deadlines

* Be able to solve basic Shopify problems independently



**You should not need training on Shopify basics.** We are looking for someone who can receive a task and start working on it immediately.



Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Liquid is a strong advantage.



## About the Work



We operate multiple e-commerce stores and regularly test and launch new products across different markets.



There is a continuous flow of work. Some days you may build a completely new product page and advertorial. On other days, you may adapt an existing product to a new country, create another advertorial, or improve an existing landing page.



We are looking for someone reliable who wants to work with us **long-term** and become an important part of our e-commerce operation.



## How to Apply



Please send us:



* A short introduction about your Shopify experience

* Examples of Shopify stores, landing pages, or advertorials you have built

* How many years you have worked with Shopify

* Your experience with Shopify Markets and multi-language/multi-country stores

* Your availability and expected monthly salary



Please include the word **"SHOPIFY"** at the beginning of your application so we know you have read the full job description.
